Our patch built inside rushiranpise's exact build system. Will tell us if it's our build or code.
Put rushiranpise's AAADPremiumPatch into our .mpp structure. If 1 patch appears, our mpp build is fine.
Uses v0.4.1 classes with @Metadata starting with BytecodePatch (no Compatibility in d2).

## What's new

- **AMOLED black theme.** New optional **AMOLED black theme** patch turns the whole dark appearance true black (`#000000`) — window, toolbars, tabs, nav drawer, cards, dialogs and backgrounds — so OLED/AMOLED screens switch those pixels off and battery life improves. The light appearance is untouched.
- **Rebranding is now on by default.** The recommended **Rebranding** patch renames the install/launcher package to `app.catsmoker.anime.witcher`, moves every `com.anime.witcher.*` permission under it and badges the icon with a red + — so the mod installs and runs even when the original app is still installed (fixes `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION` / `INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`).
- **Configurable Telegram handle & About credit.** The `Rebranding: Telegram & About` sub-patch now exposes `telegram handle` and `about credit` options, so the support links and the About-screen credit line are fully customizable.
- **Faster, more reliable D-pad fix.** The Android TV support patch wires `TvFocusHelper` as an Activity lifecycle callbacks object, applies the focusability pass to every activity and every dialog the app shows, and only consumes a top-bar D-pad press once focus actually moved into a content row — so in-content D-pad navigation is left untouched.
- Website metadata on the patch source points to the original app page.

| Android TV | off |
| Android TV: D-pad navigation | off |

| Disable ads | on |

- Uses official MicroG-RE 7.3.0.
- Removes **BYD native battery experiment**. For BYD EVs, use [Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches) (Maps Car). **BYD navigation audio routing** stays.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Restart Desktop before patching another APK.

Tested on Maps `26.43.05.1002020710` on an Android 16 phone with the default patches and MicroG-RE 7.3.0.

`patches-1.5.0.mpp` SHA-256: `2547c65893132563bbf8f3cf49a1e80ff769091b5d347af4f57052aa6be97d0f`

- Supports Google Maps `26.43.00.1002020710` (#14). Maps 26.43 changed the code that sets up navigation speech, and
  **Navigation speech and TTS startup** stopped with `Unrecognized navigation TTS layout`. The patch now checks the two
  parts of that code separately. It accepts every known version from Maps 26.36 to 26.43 and still stops on code it does
  not recognize.
- The patched code for Maps `26.42.02.997557324` is unchanged.
- The other patches did not need changes for 26.43.
- Uses official MicroG-RE 7.2.2.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Restart Desktop before patching another APK.

Tested on Maps `26.43.00.1002020710` on an Android 16 phone with the default patches.

`patches-1.4.4.mpp` SHA-256: `7086a9f9352c8bd089b34c8b551e99ed91e660bfddb88492505fd75cb5821d39`

- Splits the single Maps patch into patches you can select separately (#22, thanks @sheepymeh):
  - **Google Maps for MicroG-RE** keeps MicroG-RE support and the location-settings crash fix.
  - **Device certification fix** and **Navigation speech and TTS startup** are on by default.
  - **BYD navigation audio routing** is now off by default. On a BYD head unit, turn it on when patching so navigation prompts keep using the BYD navigation audio stream.
- The patched code is unchanged. With all six patches selected, the patched app is identical to the 1.4.2 test build.
- Uses official MicroG-RE 7.2.2.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Restart Desktop before patching another APK.

Tested on Maps `26.42.02.997557324` on an Android 16 phone with the default patches.

## [1.50.0](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/compare/v1.49.0...v1.50.0) (2026-10-14)

### ✨ New Features

* **zombietsunami:** add free IAP patch ([7f322c9](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/commit/7f322c9c4a9c8d8faeb8ba30f0cdbf8dfab6f762))
Verified against Letterboxd 3.5.8. More resilient patch anchors and a hardened Stremio/Nuvio launch fallback, so the patches keep applying reliably after app updates.

### Fixed
- The Nuvio button now opens Nuvio in its own entry in the app switcher, instead of appearing merged into Letterboxd's task.

### Changed
- Refactored the Stremio/Nuvio launch code to share one helper for targeting a package, giving it its own task, and falling back to the web player, instead of repeating that logic three times.
- Simplified the internal app-selection logic from a three-state enum down to a boolean, since the third state was never actually treated differently anywhere. No user-facing behavior change beyond the task-switcher fix above.

### Changed
- **Add Stremio button** now works correctly with [Nuvio](https://github.com/tapframe/NuvioStreaming), a Stremio-addon client that also registers the stremio:// scheme but doesn't understand its URL shape. Previously, tapping the button just opened Nuvio's home screen instead of the film.
- The button now checks which of Nuvio or Stremio is installed and sends each its own correct deep link. Nuvio is preferred when both are present.
- The label and color switch to match: purple "Stremio", or blue "Nuvio" (using the blue from Nuvio's logo).

- Fix local MP4 playback, Storage grid crashes, fresh-entry download actions and imported subtitle identity.
- Translate Morphe settings into Spanish, Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese; keep the Morphe title in every locale.
- Validation: 304 automated tests, 28 isolated patch/ABI combinations, seven TV emulator profiles and 30 final-build cold launches. Exact staged coverage and limits are documented in testing/VALIDATION_0.9.0-beta.md.

## Pepper PL 8.13.02 prebuilt variants

Maintenance release: **patches and `.mpp` bundle are byte-equivalent to v1.0.0** — the only change is a fresh set of four prebuilt XAPKs targeting Pepper PL **8.13.02** (versionCode 81302) instead of 8.13.00.

If you build through Morphe Manager / `morphe-cli` you can keep using v1.0.0's bundle — there is no patch delta. The new release exists so that anyone grabbing a ready XAPK doesn't have to start from the old 8.13.00 base.

> 📦 **Also on ReVanced** → [pepper-revanced-patches v1.4.1](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — same patch set, upstream [ReVanced Patcher](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patcher) bundle for [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager).

### What changed in Pepper 8.13.02 (upstream)

Diffed against 8.13.00 — the delta is one new feature plus the usual build-time noise. **None of it touches any patch's fingerprint surface**, so every patch from v1.0.0 applies unchanged:

| Layer | Change |
|---|---|
| New feature | **Views Challenge** — weekly-visit Club-points streak system: 15 new `views_challenge_*` strings, 1 plural, 1 vector drawable (`branding_mascot_smiling.xml`), corresponding DEX |
| Strings | +15 in base APK; same 15 translated in `config.de` / `config.es` / `config.fr` splits (+4 KB each) |
| `AndroidManifest.xml` (decoded) | **no semantic change** |
| Permissions | **no change** |
| `target_sdk` / `min_sdk` | 36 / 24 — unchanged |
| Noise | Crashlytics `mapping_file_id`, `version-control-info.textproto` revision, R8 service renames (`c95→e95`, `i18→r18`, `rr2→sr2` under `META-INF/services/`), regenerated `baseline.prof` / `baseline.profm` |

All 14 patches apply cleanly. Verified end-to-end against the APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants

Same 2×2 matrix as v1.0.0 (debug menu × compact cards):

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Each XAPK ships:
- patched **base** APK (DEX-rewritten, all default-on patches applied)
- `config.arm64_v8a` + `config.xxxhdpi` splits
- `config.en` + `config.pl` language splits

For any other ABI / DPI / language combo, grab the matching split from the unpatched APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK and side-load alongside via `adb install-multiple`.

## Morphe port — v1.0.0

This is the **first release of the Morphe port** of [pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches). The patch set and prebuilt APK variants mirror the upstream ReVanced **v1.4.0** release one-for-one — same fingerprints, same smali stubs, same telemetry coverage — but compiled against [Morphe Patcher 1.5.0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patcher/releases/tag/v1.5.0) for the [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) ecosystem.

If you came here looking for the ReVanced equivalent, it lives at [PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches).

---

### Visual diff

**Pixel 10a (420 dpi):**
![Pixel 10a — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/screenshots/screenshots/phone-comparison.png?v=2)

**Pixel 9 Pro XL (480 dpi):**
![Pixel 9 Pro XL — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/screenshots/screenshots/emu-comparison.png?v=2)

Same `Najgorętsze` tab on both devices. **Left of each pair:** the standard
Pepper 8.13.00 deal-list (3 deals fit per screen). **Right of each pair:**
`Compact deal cards` enabled (4+ deals fit, thumbnails 92 dp, vote buttons
32 dp, denser title/price stack, skeleton placeholder bars sized to match
the real button's visible area).

This release adds patch **#7 Compact deal cards** and reorganises the prebuilt
APKs around a 2×2 matrix (debug menu × compact cards), so you can pick the
exact combination you want without flipping toggles in Morphe Manager.

### What's new

#### Patch #7 — Compact deal cards (opt-in)
Resource-only patch that shrinks the redesigned 8.x deal-list cards and their
loading skeletons toward the denser pre-redesign density. Targeted XML edits
to `item_deal_thread_card.xml`, `item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and
`item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`.

Per-element changes (real card):

| Element | Original | After patch | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_image` | 108×108dp, marginTop=8 | **92×92dp**, marginTop=4, marginBottom=8 | smaller thumbnail with a guaranteed 8 dp gap above the comment row |
| `deal_thread_button_vote_*` | 36×36dp | **32×32dp** | thinner up/down vote pills |
| `deal_thread_text_temperature` | `Subtitle2` + minHeight 36 + body2 autosize | **`CaptionBold`** + minHeight 32 + caption autosize | 2-3 digit temperature fits the new 92 dp temperature box |
| `top_barrier barrierMargin` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | tighter gap below the optional sponsored header |
| `thread_text_title` | maxLines=4, marginTop=8, vertical_bias=0.5 | **maxLines=2**, marginTop=4, vertical_bias=0.25 | title clamps to 2 lines and hugs the top of its space |
| `thread_text_username marginBottom` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | less padding above the get-deal button |
| `thread_button_comment_count` | 48×48 dp, Start=parent | **32×32 dp**, Start=guideline_start | smaller comment button that respects the card's left guideline |
| `comment_count` | maxWidth=38, marginStart=38, Start=button | **maxWidth=42, gravity=center_vertical, height=32, Start_toEndOf=button** | comment count number renders **next to** the button instead of overlapping it via the original `marginStart=38dp` hack |
| `deal_thread_button_get_deal*` (×3) | wrap_content + Material default insets | **minHeight=40dp + insetTop=0 + insetBottom=0** + Baseline_toBaselineOf removed | the Material3 Button.Icon style ships with `insetTop=6dp`/`insetBottom=6dp` defaults — on a 40 dp View that leaves only 28 dp of orange button area, which clipped the Subtitle2 text. Zeroing the insets restores the full 40 dp visible area. |

Skeleton (`item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and `item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`):
- `placeholder_temperature_box` 108×36 → **92×32**
- `placeholder_image` 108×108 → **92×92**
- `placeholder_text_title` height 52 → **24** (single bar instead of two-line block)
- `placeholder_date / merchant / username` width 104 → **80**
- `placeholder_button_get_deal` height stays at 40 but margins drop 8 → **4**
- `placeholder_comment_and_share` 64×24 → **48×32** (matches the real comment button's 32 dp height)
- sponsored-only: `thread_header_text minHeight` 32 → **24** (smaller "SPONSORED" header bar)

All placeholder dimensions now match the real card 1:1, so the loading skeleton
snaps to the final layout instead of jumping when data arrives.

The patch is **opt-in** (`default = false`) — it only runs when you tick it in
Morphe Manager, or pass `-e "Compact deal cards"` to the CLI.

## SoundCloud

- Fix the login crash reported in [#2](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/issues/2): `VerifyError: branch offset of zero not allowed`. The Go+ patch now uses valid branch targets and preserves the `Feature` constructor's registers.
- Add **experimental** support for `2026.09.23-release` across all five SoundCloud patches. `2026.08.26-release` remains supported.

## Parcello

- Add the **Disable ads** patch for Parcello `2.2.20` (Android 8.0+), removing AdMob ads, advertising consent prompts and sponsored/promotional banners.
- Preserve package tracking, barcode scanning, notifications and purchase entitlements.
- Parcello support is **experimental**.

## Updating

Refresh this patch source in Morphe Manager and re-patch an **original, unmodified APK/APKM** using the v1.4.0 bundle. Existing patched installations do not receive the SoundCloud fix automatically.

## Validation

Automated regression checks and local patching/DEX checks passed for both supported SoundCloud versions. All five patches together also passed resource and DEX output checks on `2026.09.23-release`. Parcello passed local patching, resource/DEX compilation and JavaScript behavior checks.

On-device validation is still pending. Parcello `2.2.20` and SoundCloud `2026.09.23-release` remain marked as experimental.

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed streaming AND downloads still broken in v1.33.0. MovieBox added a new X-Client-Build header requirement on Oct 27 — without it the server refuses streams and downloads, showing "No stream for this title". Hushfeed v0.80.0 has 143 patches for global TikTok 47.6.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and it's TikTok only now. PineDrama moved to its own patch set, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), so add that source in Morphe Manager to keep patching PineDrama. This bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.1.0. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer), because older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.6.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and keep the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can lock the feed during hours you pick, keep saves off mobile data, slide to change the hold speed and turn the bottom bar into a floating glass pill. Messages someone unsends can stay in the chat, a double tap can take a like back off, and every patch has Morphe options for its starting values.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Passkey sign-in (#102). `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey.
* Missing notifications (#126, #222, #86). Diagnostics counts how many notifications were registered and posted, and leaves out what they said.
* Lag when a video starts (#150). Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward.
* A video playing behind the comments (#151). The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update.
* Low download quality (#240). Saving on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it beats TikTok's own file, which is often the 1080p HEVC one.
* Tabs over LIVE and drama text (#250). With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line stay above the tabs.
* Comments beside the video (#253). It measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild.
* Two videos playing at once (#257). The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page.
* The Caution label in messages (#258). `Hide unverified content notices` takes it off videos people share with you too, and country flags stay next to names written right to left.
* Full height comments under the status bar (#261). The sheet stops below the clock, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too. The "Swipe up to skip" line on suggested accounts sits above the tabs again.
* The activity center in AMOLED (#263). Its card is black, or your picked color, instead of TikTok's dark gray.
* Dark text in a LIVE comment box (#267). What you type there reads light on the AMOLED dark theme.
* Likes missing from Liked (#269). Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids even with an ad or paid partnership mark, and a like TikTok turns down now tells you why.
* Profile links from Telegram (#276). Each link replaces the pages you opened from the last one, and Back from the profile goes straight to the chat.
* LIVEs in the feed (#277). `Hide LIVE videos` catches the ones TikTok slips into a page that's already on screen.
* Face effects that can't find a face (#285). `Remove creation tools` doesn't empty the face model on its own anymore. Leave that patch out if you use face effects or make videos.
* Streaks with emoji or group names (#289). `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A second video opened from Favorites, Likes or a profile doesn't flash the search bar before it clears.
* The Service+ line under LIVEs (#94). `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` keeps it off, and the line stays with its own LIVE.

For feature requests and contributions

* Sharper story saves (#155, #287). Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy it has. Thanks to @jutochoppa.
* Stickers (#156, #88). `Create stickers` puts a Create button on the sticker panel's Saved page and `Make sticker` on a video's share sheet, and `Keep recent stickers` keeps the Recently used row after a restart. PineDrama support, the rest of #156, lives in HushPine now.
* Better sorting (#180). Liked grids get their own sort.
* Latest on Following (#226). With `Latest first on Following` on, every read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts.
* Bands between videos (#232). The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under the see-through bars.
* Stories for creators who are LIVE (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too.
* The Auto scroll button on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round one at the top right.
* Links in bios (#247). An @username in a bio opens that profile, and a long press on someone else's bio copies it.
* Hold speed slider and double tap unlike (#248). `Slide to change the hold speed` and the `Like or unlike the video` choice come from OmerKurdi79's fork.
* Search from a gesture (#251). `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page, and `Hide the Back button there too` clears the top of opened videos.
* A smaller comment search (#254). `Fold the search into a button` turns the box into a magnifier.
* Starting values for settings (#256). Every patch with settings has Morphe options for them. Thanks to @XEGARE.
* The glass bottom bar (#259). The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill. Thanks to @amfakh, whose pull request it's based on.
* The LIVE row on Following (#262). `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes it away.
* The Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings (#264). `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes it out.
* LIVE recordings (#265). Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button, and the notification has a Stop button.
* Copying from a LIVE profile card (#268). Long press the bio, name or username to copy it.
* Shop buttons under captions (#271). `Hide TikTok Shop` takes those out too.
* MP3 saves (#273). `Sound format` has an MP3 choice.
* The sticker save box (#274). `Save box for chat stickers` turns it off.
* Material You icons (#280). `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style and an icon background color.
* Auto translate (#282). `Auto translate comments` works on TikTok's newer comment list, and the translate icon's off state holds.
* Music from other apps (#283). `Let other apps play until a video starts` keeps it playing until a video does.
* Ads in microseries (#286). `Remove feed ads` refuses the ads microseries ask for in their player.
* Unsent messages (#291). `Keep unsent messages` keeps them in the chat. Thanks to @maayan080.
* Interested buttons on videos (#293). `Hide surveys` hides them.
* A sharper notification icon (Discussion #114). `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option.
* Blocking a LIVE host (Discussion #138). `Block author button` works on LIVEs in For You.

New in this release

- PineDrama moved out to its own repo, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), with its own patches and releases. Hushfeed is TikTok only from here on, and `Allow photo comments` went with PineDrama.
- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.6.3, and only that one. 47.5.3 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.6.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- `Hide the Clear display controls` has a new `Keep the progress bar` switch under it. The exit and pause buttons still go, but the progress bar stays on screen so you can see where you are and drag it (#237).
- `Double tap` has a new `Like or unlike the video` choice. A double tap on a video you've already liked takes the like back off, the same as tapping the heart, and `Confirm before liking` still asks first. TikTok's default double tap still only likes, and it works for each corner with `Double tap by corner` too (#248).
- `Slide to change the hold speed` lets you pick the speed while you hold a video. Slide left or right and it steps through your own `Speed menu choices`, with a bubble near the top showing the speed. Let go and the video goes back to its usual speed, and your next hold starts at the speed you slid to. With `Lock the hold speed with a pull down` on, pulling down locks the speed you slid to, and unlocking plays your default speed when `Use a default playback speed` is on. It's off by default and sits right under `Speed while you hold the video`. The idea comes from OmerKurdi79's fork (#248).
- Liked grids get their own sort. `Sort loaded videos on Liked grids` starts at `Same as profile grids`, so nothing changes until you pick something else, and the sort button on a Liked grid now changes only the Liked order. Posts, Favorites and private videos still follow the profile setting, and other kinds of grids keep TikTok's order (#180).
- Every Hushfeed title (the settings bar, its dialogs, the Feature Gate Lab and the lock screen) now wears TikTok's cyan and red in a slow moving gradient, and it keeps moving even with Android's animations turned off.
- The Calm feed preset is gone from the top of Feed filter. The filters it used to flip are all still there, and whatever you turned on with it stays on.
- `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page now. It works with `Hide feed search button` on too, so you can hide the button and still get to Search (#251).
- `Fold the search into a button` puts a magnifier at the top left of the comments in place of the search box. Tap it to search, and searching (or another tap) folds the box away again. Your search keeps filtering, and the result line stays so you can tell (#254).
- `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes Hushfeed out of TikTok's Settings and privacy. Press and hold For You at the top of the feed to open the settings after that, or Home when `Long-press Home for Hushfeed settings` is on. Pausing Hushfeed brings the row back (#264).
- An @username typed into someone's bio is a link now, like the ones TikTok already links. Tap it and that profile opens. Tapping the rest of the bio still translates it, and a long press still copies it. A name right after "IG:" or "Snap" stays plain, since it belongs to another app. Turn it off with `Tap @names in bios` (#247).
- The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill now. A lens slides across the tabs as you switch, you can slide along the pill to change tabs, and haptics are optional. Interface has new settings for the blur, the glass opacity, the pill's height and its corners (#259).
- Every patch with settings now has Morphe options that pick its starting values, so a build can ship with the switches you want already on. Saved choices still win, and Reset goes back to the value you picked. Thanks to @XEGARE (#256).
- `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes away the row of LIVE and story circles at the top of Following, along with the Story pill that opens it. The video starts right under the tabs with no empty band, and it stays that way after a swipe or Clear display. For You and the LIVE tab look the same as before (#262).
- `Skip the Share to sheet after a save` stops the Share to sheet TikTok pops up a few seconds after its own downloader saves a video. The share button works like before and the saved notice still shows.
- `Save details beside the video` covers photo posts now. Saving a post's original photos also writes one file for the whole post with its caption, creator, link and post date, plus which photos you picked and which ones saved. `Save details as JSON` works for it too. A Retry after some photos failed updates that same file instead of adding a second one, and if the file can't be written you're told separately from the photos.
- Search knows the everyday names for a few features now. Try "autoplay", "PiP", "AI" or "save photos". It also finds a choice row by any of its options, whichever one it's set to. Search "save the frame" and `Double tap` comes up, and tapping it opens its list of choices. Titles that match what you typed still come first.
- `Lock the feed at set times` locks the feed by itself during hours you pick, like `Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00`. Leave the days out and it's every day, and a time that ends before it starts runs past midnight. It follows your phone's clock, daylight saving changes included. The lock panel says when it opens again, and the row shows when the next lock starts. Messages, profiles and search still work while it's on. A spent daily budget still wins, and Pause Hushfeed turns it off. Cutting hours waits a day, just like budget changes do, and you can't take hours off a day that's already locked.
- `Save only on Wi-Fi` keeps saves off mobile data. On a metered network, or when the phone can't tell, a save waits for Wi-Fi (or any network that isn't metered) for up to 30 minutes. A waiting save doesn't take one of the `Saves at once` spots, and you can cancel it from the Downloads page. Leave Wi-Fi in the middle of a save and it stops cleanly, with the finished files kept. Saving a frame still works anywhere. It's off by default.
- `Save box for chat stickers` in Downloads turns off the Save media box Hushfeed opens when you tap a sticker someone sent you in a chat. With it off, the tap only does what TikTok does (#274).
- `Let other apps play until a video starts` sits under `Mute feed videos` in Playback. With it on, opening TikTok or going back and forth to your messages doesn't pause music from another app anymore. TikTok takes the sound once a video actually plays. It's off by default (#283).
- New `Keep unsent messages` switch in Inbox. When someone unsends a message to you, it stays in the chat, and `Mark kept messages` can add "(unsent)" after it. Messages you unsend yourself still go away, and `Clear kept messages` turns the kept ones back into TikTok's usual notice. It's off by default. Thanks to @maayan080 (#291).
- `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` sits with the LIVE switches in Playback. A LIVE in the feed can carry a Service+ line under the creator's name, like "Ask me anything", and this keeps it off. The line also stays with its own LIVE now. It used to hang on from the LIVE before whenever the row came back on screen, so a LIVE with no Service+ item showed the last one's. The switch is off by default (#94).
- With `Latest first on Following` on, every Following read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts instead of its smaller count. A long list takes fewer reads, and fewer newer posts turn up after you've already scrolled past older ones (#226).
- The profile card in a LIVE room works like a profile now. Long press the bio to copy it, the name to copy the name, or the username to copy the user ID. A small copy mark after the username copies the handle with one tap (#268).
- `Hide TikTok Shop` takes the shop buttons out from under captions too, the ones that link to a product or open a shopping search with the bag icon. A plain search tag under a caption still shows (#271).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option now. Pick Hushfeed's H and TikTok's notifications show a sharp H in the status bar instead of the note. TikTok ships that note as one small picture that gets stretched on most phones, so it often looks soft. Leave the option alone and nothing changes (Discussion #114).
- `Sound format` has a third choice, MP3. Both sound saves (the one beside a video and the long-press `Save the original sound`) can come out as a plain .mp3 that plays anywhere. A sound TikTok already sent as MP3 is saved untouched, and anything else is converted on the phone at its own sample rate. MP3 works on every Android version, so the row doesn't grey out below Android 10 anymore. If a conversion fails you get the sound the way TikTok sent it (#273).
- `Also on opened videos` (under `Hide the search button on the feed`) has a `Hide the Back button there too` switch now. It also takes away the Back arrow beside that hidden search bar, so a video opened from search or a profile shows nothing at the top. Your phone's back gesture still works (#251).
- With `Block author button` on, a LIVE that shows up in For You gets the block button too. One tap blocks its host, and the feed moves on like it does after a video. The sound, feedback and mute buttons stay off LIVEs, since they don't apply there (Discussion #138).
- New `Create stickers` patch, on by default. A patched app only gets the basic comment sticker panel, which has no way to make a sticker, so its Saved page gets a Create button. Pick a photo and it shows up first in Saved a moment later, ready to send. A video's share sheet gets `Make sticker` after Download too, and that turns the video's picture into one of your saved stickers (#156, #88).
- New `Keep recent stickers` patch. The sticker panel's Recently used row stays filled after a restart or an account switch now, and your four newest show above Saved. Each account keeps its own row, and nothing is kept while you're signed out (#156).
- `Hide surveys` also hides the Not interested and Interested buttons TikTok sometimes lays over a video (#293).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style. On Android 12 and up the note and its background take colors from your wallpaper and switch with dark mode, even with themed icons off. Older phones get white on black. A new Icon background color option takes any color written like #1E88E5 and puts it behind the note, or behind your own picture, in any style (#280).
- `Leave after no touch` under Screen time is for anyone who falls asleep with the feed playing. Set it to a number of minutes and TikTok stops the video and goes to the background once nobody has touched the screen for that long, with a short message saying why. Any touch starts the wait over (a key press or a mouse wheel counts too), and so does opening a sheet like Share or the comment menu. It's off until you set it (#266).
- `Show when an account was made` puts "Joined Jan 2020" under the @username on someone else's profile, next to the follow label when that's on too. TikTok doesn't send the date, but every account's ID carries the time it was made, so it's read from there. Very old accounts from the musical.ly days have short IDs with no time in them and show nothing. The same date now fills the Joined line in Account facts when TikTok leaves it out. It's off until you turn it on.
- What's new comes in Simplified Chinese now, the way the settings already did. A phone set to Simplified Chinese gets the translated notes instead of English ones, and Traditional Chinese still gets English.
- The Feature Gate Lab has a restart button now. It shows up on the Lab page once a change needs a restart, the same as on the settings pages, and TikTok opens back on the Lab afterwards. Rules saved while overrides are off don't add to the restart count, since TikTok hasn't read them. The messages after forcing, turning off or resetting gates don't tell you to restart anymore. With overrides off there's nothing to restart for, and with them on the button is right there. Turning overrides on or off still says to restart, since that always needs one.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer.
- The patch bundle is signed with Morphe's own bundle signature, and the source lists the matching public key. Manager can use it to tell whether a later download really came from Hushfeed.

- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the "Swipe up to skip" line on a suggested account card in For You sits above the tabs again instead of behind them (#261).

The caption and the video's progress line move up to match, so the line no longer rides on the pill (#259).

- Categories open and close right under their rows in the main list. Search shows the matching controls in that same list, and a category you opened stays open after you rotate the phone or restart TikTok.
- The big cards on the settings home page are a compact full-width list now, and Quick setups is gone.
- Country flags and codes stay next to names written right to left (#258).
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line of LIVE previews and mini dramas stay above the tabs (#250).
- The grid sort control has a 48 dp touch target, so it's easier to hit.
- The grid sort control hides while its grid isn't showing and comes back with the grid.
- If a sort change can't be saved, the grid keeps the order it had.
- Choosing Original order keeps the current grid's sort menu available (#180).
- Comments beside the video measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild (#253).
- In Inbox, a reused chat picture now opens the current creator's Story on the first tap when Story-first is on (#233).
- The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page. Leaving the tap-to-start cover for another tab keeps its feed paused too (#257).
- Notification reports in Diagnostics count how many notifications were registered and posted, and leave out what the messages said (#126, #222, #86).
- TikTok stays in the app list Android 14 and newer show when you record a single app.
- Hold a settings-search switch to reveal and highlight its control in the main list (#248).
- Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward (#150).
- Exporting a recovered recording writes in big chunks now, so a large file doesn't take ages to save.
- Recovery Retry keeps the recording's original stop reason instead of saying TikTok closed. Recovery dialogs follow Hushfeed's theme.
- Screen recordings check storage as they run and keep recovery files until the saved copy is verified. Interrupted recordings can be retried, exported or deleted.
- The first frames of a screen recording each keep their own timestamp while the sound is starting.
- Screen recordings keep their first video frames while the sound is still starting up.
- Screen recording releases audio resources when sound can't start. Its save notice now says when the recording has no sound.
- Screen recording now asks Android to capture only the patched app's sound.
- Service+ cleanup checks the first entry in a LIVE preview now, the same one TikTok decides to show (#94).
- The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update (#151).
- `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round Auto scroll button TikTok shows at the top right of the video on some devices (#234).
- The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under `See-through status bar` and `See-through bottom bar`. Only the video grew before, so every swipe showed TikTok's bands for a frame (#232).
- `Remove feed ads` also refuses the ad microseries ask for in their player. That request went around the feed ad filter, so an episode could still bring one (#286).
- Typing in a LIVE room's comment box reads light on the AMOLED dark theme. The panel went black with the rest of the room, but its text box kept TikTok's dark text and hint, so what you typed was dark on black (#267).
- `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats. Those entries were cut at the first character a username can't hold, and the field's keyboard wouldn't even let you type them. A group is named the way your Inbox shows it, and one you haven't opened since the last restart is named in the answer so you know to open it (#289).
- Opening TikTok links from Telegram one after another no longer piles a whole For You feed under every profile. Memory stayed high and grew with each link, and Back went from feed to feed instead of out of TikTok. Now each link replaces the pages you'd opened from the last one, and Back from the profile takes you straight back to the chat you came from (#276). That holds when you open a video from the profile, share it and come back to TikTok through Recents. Back used to land on the home screen there.
- `Auto translate comments` works again on accounts TikTok moved to its newer comment list, where nothing got translated. Foreign comments switch to your language as they scroll in, and one you've flipped back with See original stays that way (#282).
- `Hide LIVE videos` catches the LIVEs TikTok slips into a For You page that's already on screen. Those used to get through because Hushfeed leaves TikTok's fresh inserts alone, and the other filters still do (#277).
- The translate icon at the top of the comments shows on while `Auto translate comments` is working, and turning it off now holds. It stays off on every video and every page you scroll to until you tap it back on or flip the switch. Before, it only reset the comments on screen, and TikTok put translation back each time the comments closed (#282).
- `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too. TikTok ranks the LIVE ahead of the Story there, so the tap went into the LIVE (#233).
- Saving a video on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it's taller than TikTok's own file. TikTok's clean file is often 720p H.264 with a 1080p HEVC listed right beside it, so saves came out smaller than they had to. With the watermark kept you still get TikTok's stamped copy (#240).
- Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy the story has, the one the player shows. With `Show download progress` or a few other download switches on, it used to save a smaller 720p copy. Thanks to @jutochoppa (#287, #155).
- Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button anymore. It hides as the recording starts and comes back once the file is saved. The recording's notification has a Stop button, and leaving the room still stops and saves it (#265).
- `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey. That page lists only the ways your account has set up, so add email or text as a way to verify on tiktok.com or another phone first, then sign in (#102).
- `Remove creation tools` never empties the face model on its own anymore, on a build with no editor and effect files, since that left face effects and Beauty unable to find a face (#285). TikTok 47.6.3's split bundle has those files again, so it now works there like it does on the universal APK and the Create tab stops working. Leave it out if you make videos.
- When TikTok turns down a like, Hushfeed tells you. The heart still fills when you tap it, but a like the server refused is gone after a restart, so the first one each session now shows TikTok's reason, or its error code when it gives none. Comment likes count too. With logging on, the diagnostics report says whether each like went through (#269).
- Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids now, even when they carry an ad, a paid partnership or a commission mark. `Remove feed ads` and the other feed filters used to take those off the grids too, so a like went through but the video never showed on Liked. The For You and Following feeds still drop them (#269).
- The Chinese message for a refused follow says 关注 now. It used to read "follow" as "the following".
- The floating tab pill blurs a LIVE preview in For You behind it too. Ordinary videos were already blurred there, but a LIVE's stream showed sharp through the glass (#259).
- Around 140 pop-up messages are shorter now, so they fit in the two lines Android 12 and later gives them. The longer ones got cut off partway through, often right where they said what to do next. For some of them the English already fit, and only the translations were trimmed.
- The Feature Gate Lab's pop-up messages fit in two lines now too, and so do the ones you get when a settings change that was cut short gets sorted out on the next launch. An import that brings in nothing new opens the same results dialog as any other import, so you can see what already matched or isn't in this TikTok version. That dialog has no Undo button, since the only thing left to undo would be the Lab change before it. Short hints like "Enter a number" no longer end in a stray full stop, in the Lab or in number fields.
- The Simplified Chinese settings read more evenly. They talk to you the same way throughout and use one word each for an account and a region. Galaxy Store and AppGallery show their real store names, and a few labels that came out wrong, like Own profile counts and Override store region, now say what they do.
- Comment search no longer undoes the keyword filter on translated comments. With both on, a translated comment the filter hid got its space in the list back every time the list drew it again. It now stays hidden whatever the search box holds.
- Picking a download folder that can't be used, like one under Music or on an SD card, opens the folder box again with the folder you picked and the reason under it. It used to be a pop-up message, and the list of allowed folders in it got cut off.

Behind the scenes

- Every LIVE preview and drama label that See-through bottom bar moves is checked against the supported TikTok APK.
- The auto-advance audit follows the video player itself instead of per-video labels. A clip that doesn't finish, or playback it can't read, leaves the check inconclusive.
- The whole-app walk checks the installed build and its patch options.
- Patch audits check the installed APK and which patches were picked. Results from another app, or from a patch left out of the build, only count as history.
- A patch audit waits for the full diagnostics report before it calls a switch missing. With no video to look at, the checks that need one stay inconclusive, and the commenter region check reads the current cache trace.
- A patch audit stops counting for a build once the code it ran against changes, and a partial rerun leaves the older checks as history.
- The patch bundle carries Gson 2.15.0, up from 2.14.0. Morphe Manager uses it while patching to read the patch defaults.
- The Licenses page under About and the NOTICE file now credit De-Vanced, where a few of the build files came from. Those files, and the telemetry patch taken from hxreborn's fork, now link the copies they were actually taken from instead of ReVanced pages that never held them.
- Releases don't carry `release-receipt-<version>.json` anymore. The bundle is byte reproducible, so you can build the tag yourself and compare the checksum.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.6.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).

What was checked

* All 143 TikTok patches applied to TikTok 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.6.3 and run on an Android emulator. A walk through the whole app opened 27 screens with no crash.
* Android's own code verifier then read every class of the patched app on that same device, and it found nothing that unpatched TikTok 47.6.3 doesn't already have.

Hushfeed v0.79.0 has 141 patches. 140 of them are for global TikTok 47.5.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and 95 work on PineDrama 47.5.3, one of those made just for it. It needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 2.0.0.

TikTok stays on 47.5.3, so the TikTok APK you already have is fine to patch again. PineDrama moves to 47.5.3, so grab that one from APKMirror before you patch it. PineDrama got a lot of attention in this one. Six more patches run on it, and photo comments and imported fonts work there now. On TikTok there's a spam comment filter and a way to record a LIVE straight off the screen, and `Hide videos you have already seen` keeps watched videos out of For You again.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Repeats in For You (#172). `Hide videos you have already seen` checks each new For You page once TikTok hands it over, so videos you watched stop coming back.
* The comment bar on photo posts (#171). With `AMOLED dark theme`, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post is black instead of letting the photo show through.
* Fonts on PineDrama (#243). `Use an imported font` now draws PineDrama's text in your font, and bold text stays bold.
* Missing saved stickers (#214). PineDrama's sticker panel loads every sticker you saved. It used to stop at 100.
* Low download quality (#240). When the quality list stops below 720p, it also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC file if that one is taller, and the diagnostic report shows why each quality was or wasn't offered.
* Commenter countries (#201). `Show where commenters are from` remembers people's countries from their earlier comments and videos, so it finds one more often.
* Running out of memory while patching (#220). The README says to give morphe-desktop 2 GB with `java -Xmx2g`.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A search result you open again clears again, even if you brought its buttons back by hand last time.

For feature requests

* PineDrama (#156). It moves to 47.5.3, six more patches run on it, and a new `Allow photo comments` patch lets the comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments like TikTok does. Hushfeed's settings also say to restart PineDrama now, not TikTok.
* A spam shield for comments (#187). `Hide spam comments` hides the bots that point you to their bio or hand out a contact, and leaves the creator's own comments alone.
* Effects that refuse older phones (#176). `Report a newer phone to effects` tells the effects server you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra.
* Saving LIVEs (#37). `LIVE recording source` can record the screen as you watch, and Share > Video quality now shows in gaming and football rooms too.
* LIVE recording presets (#203). `LIVE recording quality` offers Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p and takes a room's 60 fps stream when it has one. You can change it from a LIVE room's Share sheet too.
* The liquid glass bar (#231). `Blur the video behind the bar` frosts the pill with the video under it, and the lens slides between tabs every time now.
* Dark LIVE rooms (#159). The light bits left in rooms turn dark, from the profile card's tiles to the menu's navigation bar, and a room stays dark when your phone switches themes.
* The Auto scroll switch on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` hides the switch beside the avatar too, with or without Auto-advance.
* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). Clear display lets go with your swipe, and the See-through bottom bar no longer drops the caption over the tabs after each swipe.
* An instant pause (#239). With double tap set to do nothing, a tap pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first` keeps everything below your video in date order as posts load, and the tab starts on the newest post.
* Better sorting (#180). Profile grids get Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid loads up to 300 videos by itself, and swiping through them keeps that order.
* Stories from LIVE creators (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` opens their Story from their profile picture or your chat with them, and the next tap joins the LIVE.
* LIVE quality in dark mode (#57). The newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable on dark mode.
* Add to Story (#88). `Allow Add to Story anyway` brings the button back when a creator turned off content reuse.
* Time zones (#184, #198). With `Match locale and timezone` on, chat dates follow the preset's zone.
* Thoughts (#186). `Turn on Thoughts` shows Thoughts for accounts TikTok left out.
* Original image formats (#229). Stickers that don't move are saved as TikTok sent them too.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` also covers the front flash and the fill light.
* Region locked features (#98). Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset says up front that only some videos get scrolling comments.

## What's changed

* On PineDrama, Hushfeed's settings now tell you to restart PineDrama instead of TikTok. That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. Other mentions of TikTok, like its servers or the TikTok Sans font, stay as they are (#156).
* New `Hide spam comments` switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments, off by default (#187). It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. It knows the common phrasings in English and the languages Hushfeed's settings come in, plus French. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).
* New `Allow photo comments` patch for PineDrama, with its switch off by default (#156). PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Turn the switch on in Hushfeed settings > Comments and restart, and the comment box asks the server like TikTok does.
* PineDrama moves to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new PineDrama from APKMirror before you patch it again. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. PineDrama 47.5.3 has no stories, HD upload choice or foldable comment panel, so `Story controls`, `Always upload in HD` and `Foldable split comment view` are TikTok only now. That makes 95 patches Morphe Manager offers for PineDrama. The rest lean on TikTok's LIVE rooms, feed buttons or resources that PineDrama doesn't have (#156).
* New `Report a newer phone to effects` switch, off by default (#176). Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". With the switch on, the effects server is told you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra. Sign-in and everything else still see your real phone. An effect your phone really can't run may still fail or look wrong.
* New `Load all saved stickers` patch, with no switch. PineDrama's sticker panel loaded only the first 100 stickers you saved and never asked for more, so the rest were missing from Saved. It now asks for all of them in one go. TikTok gets the same first request, and it still loads more by itself past that (#214).
* New `LIVE recording source` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Stream only` saves the room's own video like before. `Screen` records what your phone shows while you watch. Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. Both showed there because the Home tab stays selected on those tabs, and the filtered count sat right over their search boxes. They still show on For You and Following.
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a room's viewer ranking opens dark again. A shop room's Top customers ranking still keeps TikTok's light look, because its tab titles came out dark on dark (#159).
* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. TikTok used to hold each tap for a beat in case a second one followed, and two quick taps counted as a double tap that did nothing. Now each one counts (#239).
* The build uses Gradle 9.8.2, up from 9.7.1. The build files now name the Guava advisory by its CVE number, CVE-2026-102554, because GitHub's global advisory database doesn't list its GHSA id.
* The README now lists the parts of Hushfeed's settings that an add-on bundle patched in beside it can count on, and a test fails if one of them changes. Anything else in the settings code can still move between releases.
* What's new now carries only the newest releases' notes, and its Full changelog button has the rest. Every release since 0.60.0 used to be built in, in all nine languages, and those notes alone were about 14% of the extension's size.
* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).
* New `Turn on Thoughts` switch in Hushfeed settings > App. It shows Thoughts on profiles and in your inbox, plus the prompt to share one, for accounts TikTok left out. It starts off, and TikTok's servers can still refuse a post (#186).
* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).
* `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` now also covers the front flash and the fill light, which used to push the screen to full brightness on their own. The flash still turns the screen white, just at your own brightness (#200).

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Video controls that wouldn't stay put (#209). `Keep faded controls in Clear display` keeps the like, comment, save and share buttons on screen again, and the diagnostic report no longer calls the controls broken on accounts without the Following stories button.
* Commenting in LIVE (#110). With `Log diagnostics` on, the report now says which LIVE room each comment went to, using short codes in place of room ids.
* The time beside the progress bar (#173). A new `Where the time goes` choice can put the time above the bar, and the caption and buttons move up to make room.

For feature requests

* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). `Double tap by corner`, recent searches in Hushfeed's settings search and `Keep Clear display across videos` are in, adapted from their fork.
* Better sorting (#180). `Sort loaded videos on profile grids` sorts what a profile or Liked grid has loaded by date, length, views or likes.
* Slideshows that fit the screen (#188). `Fit the video to the screen` shows photo slideshows whole on squarer screens.
* Auto captions (#217). `Keep captions available` brings back the Captions switch TikTok hides for some accounts and regions.
* Time zone spoofing and more regions (#184, #198). `Match locale and timezone to country` makes that country's zone TikTok's own from the moment it starts.
* A seek bar for sounds (#185). `Seek bar on sound previews` lets you tap or drag through a sound's preview.
* Auto translation and Balance (#194). `Don't auto translate videos` keeps videos in their own language, and `Hide Balance in the profile menu` takes Balance out of that menu.
* Original image formats (#229). `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` saves the HEIF or WebP file as it came.
* A liquid glass tab bar (#231, #124). `Glass lens on the current tab` puts a small piece of glass behind the tab you're on.
* TikTok Minis (#230). `Hide the TikTok Minis icons in the profile menu` makes that menu shorter.
* The side menu swipe (#213). `Turn off the swipe to the side menu` stops a right swipe on For You from opening it.
* Inbox badge colors (#192). The unread count and dots now follow `Accent color` like the LIVE bubble does.
* Comments at full height (#191). `Open the comments at full height` opens the sheet all the way up.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` stops TikTok's camera from turning your screen up.
* A Watch history shortcut (#199). `Long-press Profile for Watch history` opens it from the Profile tab.
* LIVE recording quality (#203). `LIVE recording quality` can record the room's best stream or its smallest one.
* Fullscreen video behind the tabs (#145, #218). `See-through bottom bar` keeps the video behind the tabs as you swipe, and portrait videos now reach the bottom of the screen.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first on Following` plays each batch of the Following feed newest first.
* The system font (#7). A Galaxy font picked in Android's settings now shows on TikTok's web pages too.
* Material You colors (#163). The "You may like" words on the search page take your accent color.

## What's changed

* Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.5.3 and drops 47.4.3. Grab the 47.5.3 APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, and your login and settings carry over. PineDrama stays on 47.4.3.
* `Remove unused language packs` now patches PineDrama 47.4.3 too. Its language files list the same 25 languages as TikTok's but word the list differently, and the patch stopped at that instead of trimming them.
* `Search loaded activity` puts its search bar back on the Inbox's Activity page. Since 0.77.0 the bar never showed up, because Hushfeed was still looking for TikTok's list under the names an older TikTok gave it.
* New `Double tap by corner` switch under `Double tap` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. Turn it on and each quarter of the video gets its own double tap choice, so the top left can open the comments while the bottom right keeps TikTok's like. Off, `Double tap` works like before. The idea and first version came from @OmerKurdi79 (#232).
* Settings search remembers what you looked for. With the box empty it lists your last ten searches, newest first. Tap one to run it again, tap the bin to forget it, or clear the list at the bottom. A search is kept once you press search on the keyboard, open one of its results or flip a switch it found, and the list stays out of backups (#232).
* New `Keep Clear display across videos` switch in the Clear display part of Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. It's on by default, which is how Clear display has carried over until now. Turn it off and a Clear display you turn on by hand lasts for that video only, so the next one starts with its buttons showing (#232).
* Patching is faster. Many patches used to search every class in TikTok for the code they change, and now they look it up by a string, a number or a name the patcher already keeps an index of. With every patch on 47.4.3, a desktop run went from 89 to 60 seconds and the patching step itself from 54 to 26. The APK that comes out is the same.
* `Sort loaded videos on profile grids` sorts the videos a profile or Liked grid has loaded. You can put the newest or oldest first, the longest or shortest, or the most viewed or most liked. Pinned videos stay first, videos with no value for that order go last, and new pages are sorted in as you scroll. `Original order` is TikTok's own. It only changes videos the grid has already loaded, not the ones it hasn't fetched yet (#180).
* `Fit the video to the screen` now shows photo slideshows whole on a squarer screen too. Each slide sits centered with black above and below instead of losing the top and bottom, and swiping, the dots, the caption and the music line work as before. On a normal tall phone nothing changes (#188).
* New `Keep captions available` switch under Hushfeed settings > Feed screen > Captions. TikTok hides the Captions switch in its accessibility settings, and the caption controls that go with it, for some accounts and regions. Turn this on and they come back. Captions still only show on videos that carry them. It's off by default and takes a TikTok restart to apply (#217).
* `Match locale and timezone to country` now makes that country's time zone TikTok's own from the moment it starts, daylight saving included. Before, only the zone TikTok reports changed. Hushfeed's own clocks (the daily limit's reset, the sleep timer and Auto streak's send time) stay on your phone's time (#184, #198).
* New `Seek bar on sound previews` switch under Hushfeed settings > Playback, part of `Show the progress bar`. When you play a sound's preview on its page, a line along the bottom of the cover shows how far in you are and how long the preview runs. Tap or drag it to jump around in the preview. The line goes away when the preview stops, and a sound that can't be skipped through keeps TikTok's own controls. It's off by default (#185).
* `Keep faded controls in Clear display` keeps the like, comment, save and share buttons on screen again. Newer TikTok builds hide the whole button column at once in Clear display instead of each button, so the buttons stayed away even with the switch on (#209).
* The diagnostic report no longer calls the video controls broken for accounts without the Following stories button. TikTok only shows that button to some accounts, and every Clear display without it got counted as a missing part (#209).
* The diagnostic report can now say which LIVE room a comment went to. Turn on `Log diagnostics`, and each LIVE comment line carries a short code for its room and for the room you entered last, so two comments can be compared without showing any room id (#110).
* Hushfeed now needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Update Manager before you patch. It's built on Morphe's 2.0 patcher, which only unpacks the parts of TikTok a patch asks for, so patching takes less time and memory. With every patch on, a desktop run took about half as long. From a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Manager 2.0 no longer has the `Process runtime` memory setting, so the install steps now say to leave `Use embedded VM` on under Manager's Settings > Patcher.
* New `Hide Balance in the profile menu` switch under Hushfeed settings > App. It takes Balance out of the menu your profile's top right button opens. Your coins and gifts don't change. It's off by default (#194).
* New `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` switch under Hushfeed settings > Downloads > Photos and stickers. Photos, covers and story photos you save stay the HEIF or WebP file TikTok sent instead of turning into a JPEG, for editing apps that read those. Some galleries and computers can't open them, so it's off by default (#229).
* New `Glass lens on the current tab` switch under `Liquid glass look`. A smaller piece of glass sits behind the tab you're on and slides over when you pick another one. With animations turned off in your phone's settings it just moves. The tabs and their tap areas don't change (#231, #124).
* New `Hide the TikTok Minis icons in the profile menu` switch under Hushfeed settings > App. It keeps the TikTok Minis entry in the menu your profile's top right button opens and hides the row of app icons under it, so the menu is shorter. It's off by default (#230).
* New `Turn off the swipe to the side menu` switch under Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. With it on, swiping right on For You doesn't open TikTok's side menu with Your orders and TikTok Minis, so the swipe goes to the next tab instead. It's off by default (#213).
* New `Don't auto translate videos` switch under Hushfeed settings > Comments. With TikTok's Always translate on, it translates video descriptions and captions by itself in For You, Following and Search. Turn this on and videos stay in the language they were made in. Comments follow their own switch, and tapping See translation still works on any video. It's off by default and takes a TikTok restart to apply (#194).
* With `Accent color` on, the unread count on the Inbox tab and the small unread dots now take your color too. The LIVE bubble over the Inbox tab already did, so the bubble and the count under it didn't match. Warnings still stay red (#192).
* New `Open the comments at full height` switch under Hushfeed settings > Comments. TikTok opens the comment sheet part way up the screen, and with the switch on it opens all the way to the top. Dragging it down still closes it. It's off by default (#191).
* New `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` switch under Hushfeed settings > App > System. TikTok turns your screen brighter when you open its camera, and keeps it that way through editing and posting. With the switch on, the screen stays at the brightness you set. It's off by default (#200).
* New `Long-press Profile for Watch history` switch under Feed tab navigation. Holding the Profile tab opens TikTok's Watch history right away instead of four menus deep, and a tap still opens your profile. It's off by default. On accounts where holding Profile switches accounts, the switch takes over that press while it's on (the name at the top of your profile still switches) and hands it back when you turn it off (#199).
* In Simplified Chinese, "Profile" in Hushfeed's settings (the bottom tab lists, `Open TikTok on` and the Profile section heading) read "company profile". It now says 个人主页.
* New `LIVE recording quality` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Same as the room` keeps recording what you're watching, like before. `Highest` records the best stream the room has even while you watch it lower, and `Lowest` keeps the file small (#203).
* Turning on `See-through bottom bar` while TikTok is open now keeps the video running behind the tabs as you swipe. Before, the first swipe brought the black strip under the video back, and it stayed until TikTok was restarted. Hushfeed measured the next video while it was still sliding into place and took it for a caption pushed under the tabs (#145).
* New `Hide the AI Cast button` switch under Hushfeed settings > App > Posting. It takes TikTok's AI Cast button off the camera's side toolbar, the same way TikTok already leaves it out of duets, stories and the DM camera. It starts off.
* New `Latest first on Following` switch under Feed filter. Each batch of posts the Following feed loads now plays newest first. TikTok still decides what goes in each batch, so a post from the next batch can be newer than the ones before it, and ads and LIVEs stay where TikTok put them. Restart TikTok after turning it on (#226).
* On a Galaxy, a font picked in Settings > Display > Font size and style now shows on Watch history, Activity center and TikTok's other web pages too while `Use system font` is on. Those pages kept Android's standard font before, even though the rest of TikTok followed your pick (#7).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on by itself, a portrait video now reaches the bottom of the screen behind the tabs. TikTok kept centering the picture in the taller space, so it stopped short and the bottom of the bar sat over a black band. The picture grows just enough to cover it, the same way `See-through status bar` fills the top (#145, #218).
* New `Where the time goes` choice under `Show the time beside the progress bar` in Playback. Pick `Above the bar` and, in the main feed, the caption and the buttons on the right (the music disc too) move up a little so the time fits over the right end of the bar. If something else still sits on that spot, the time stays beside the bar. Picking `Beside the bar` again or turning the time off puts everything back where TikTok had it, and so does pausing Hushfeed (#173).
* With `Accent color` on, the "You may like" words on the search page and the dot before each one now take your color too, whether it's a preset or the wallpaper's. TikTok sends those words with a red of their own instead of using the app's colors, so they stayed red before (#163).
* Two new rows under Hushfeed settings > Downloads. `Saves right now` lists the saves under way, oldest first, and says what each one is doing or how many saves it's waiting on. Its Cancel takes a save out of line, or stops a save of several files after the one it's on. Under them, the last five saves that finished stay listed, each with what it said when it was done (like "Saved 27 videos") or a note that it was cancelled or stopped on an error. `Saves at once` sets how many saves run together, from 1 to 3, and the rest wait their turn (#27).

# Haiagaru 1.25.0-dev.1

外部板の板一覧、設定リンク、226の検索メニュー、動画サムネイルと全レスのメディア表示を更新した検証用プレリリースです。

## 主な変更

- 191で外部板の板一覧にJavaScriptの文字列が混ざる問題を修正しました。登録した外部板をサイト別に板一覧の最上位へ表示するオプションも追加しました（初期OFF、変更後は再起動）。
- 書き込みからHaiagaru設定を開く・オン／オフする設定リンクと、日本語のリンク作成画面を追加しました。タップ時に現在値と変更内容を表示し、「適用」を押すまで変更しません。
- 226のタブレット表示で、ツールバーから検索を隠した際にも、板名をタップして開くメニューから検索できるようにしました。
- 大きな `video.twimg.com` のMP4では、動画全体のサイズが取得上限を超えていても、容量・時間の上限内で必要な範囲を取得してサムネイル生成を試みます。サーバー応答や動画の構造により生成できない場合は従来の表示を維持します。サムネイルの取得設定もご確認ください。
- サムネイル生成に失敗した場合は、通信・DNS・容量上限・時間切れ・解析失敗などの理由を表示します。「再取得」でサムネイルを再試行でき、「再生」からは取得結果に左右されず元の動画を開けます。解析用プロセスのメモリ不足などによる終了後も、待機後または明示的な再取得で再試行します。
- 「サムネイルから全レスの画像・GIF・動画へ移動」に名称を統一し、ChMate標準の「複数あるときは連続表示ビューア」「常に1枚目から表示」の指定にも対応しました。対象は読み込み済みで表示対象になっているレスのメディアです。検証版で191の連続表示切り替え時に起きたクラッシュも修正し、226・242にも同じ保護を適用しました。
