Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Passkey sign-in (#102). `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey.
* Missing notifications (#126, #222, #86). Diagnostics counts how many notifications were registered and posted, and leaves out what they said.
* Lag when a video starts (#150). Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward.
* A video playing behind the comments (#151). The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update.
* Low download quality (#240). Saving on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it beats TikTok's own file, which is often the 1080p HEVC one.
* Tabs over LIVE and drama text (#250). With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line stay above the tabs.
* Comments beside the video (#253). It measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild.
* Two videos playing at once (#257). The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page.
* The Caution label in messages (#258). `Hide unverified content notices` takes it off videos people share with you too, and country flags stay next to names written right to left.
* Full height comments under the status bar (#261). The sheet stops below the clock, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too. The "Swipe up to skip" line on suggested accounts sits above the tabs again.
* The activity center in AMOLED (#263). Its card is black, or your picked color, instead of TikTok's dark gray.
* Dark text in a LIVE comment box (#267). What you type there reads light on the AMOLED dark theme.
* Likes missing from Liked (#269). Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids even with an ad or paid partnership mark, and a like TikTok turns down now tells you why.
* Profile links from Telegram (#276). Each link replaces the pages you opened from the last one, and Back from the profile goes straight to the chat.
* LIVEs in the feed (#277). `Hide LIVE videos` catches the ones TikTok slips into a page that's already on screen.
* Face effects that can't find a face (#285). `Remove creation tools` doesn't empty the face model on its own anymore. Leave that patch out if you use face effects or make videos.
* Streaks with emoji or group names (#289). `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A second video opened from Favorites, Likes or a profile doesn't flash the search bar before it clears.
* The Service+ line under LIVEs (#94). `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` keeps it off, and the line stays with its own LIVE.

For feature requests and contributions

* Sharper story saves (#155, #287). Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy it has. Thanks to @jutochoppa.
* Stickers (#156, #88). `Create stickers` puts a Create button on the sticker panel's Saved page and `Make sticker` on a video's share sheet, and `Keep recent stickers` keeps the Recently used row after a restart. PineDrama support, the rest of #156, lives in HushPine now.
* Better sorting (#180). Liked grids get their own sort.
* Latest on Following (#226). With `Latest first on Following` on, every read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts.
* Bands between videos (#232). The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under the see-through bars.
* Stories for creators who are LIVE (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too.
* The Auto scroll button on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round one at the top right.
* Links in bios (#247). An @username in a bio opens that profile, and a long press on someone else's bio copies it.
* Hold speed slider and double tap unlike (#248). `Slide to change the hold speed` and the `Like or unlike the video` choice come from OmerKurdi79's fork.
* Search from a gesture (#251). `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page, and `Hide the Back button there too` clears the top of opened videos.
* A smaller comment search (#254). `Fold the search into a button` turns the box into a magnifier.
* Starting values for settings (#256). Every patch with settings has Morphe options for them. Thanks to @XEGARE.
* The glass bottom bar (#259). The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill. Thanks to @amfakh, whose pull request it's based on.
* The LIVE row on Following (#262). `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes it away.
* The Hushfeed row in TikTok's settings (#264). `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes it out.
* LIVE recordings (#265). Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button, and the notification has a Stop button.
* Copying from a LIVE profile card (#268). Long press the bio, name or username to copy it.
* Shop buttons under captions (#271). `Hide TikTok Shop` takes those out too.
* MP3 saves (#273). `Sound format` has an MP3 choice.
* The sticker save box (#274). `Save box for chat stickers` turns it off.
* Material You icons (#280). `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style and an icon background color.
* Auto translate (#282). `Auto translate comments` works on TikTok's newer comment list, and the translate icon's off state holds.
* Music from other apps (#283). `Let other apps play until a video starts` keeps it playing until a video does.
* Ads in microseries (#286). `Remove feed ads` refuses the ads microseries ask for in their player.
* Unsent messages (#291). `Keep unsent messages` keeps them in the chat. Thanks to @maayan080.
* Interested buttons on videos (#293). `Hide surveys` hides them.
* A sharper notification icon (Discussion #114). `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option.
* Blocking a LIVE host (Discussion #138). `Block author button` works on LIVEs in For You.

New in this release

- PineDrama moved out to its own repo, [HushPine](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPine), with its own patches and releases. Hushfeed is TikTok only from here on, and `Allow photo comments` went with PineDrama.
- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.6.3, and only that one. 47.5.3 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.6.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- `Hide the Clear display controls` has a new `Keep the progress bar` switch under it. The exit and pause buttons still go, but the progress bar stays on screen so you can see where you are and drag it (#237).
- `Double tap` has a new `Like or unlike the video` choice. A double tap on a video you've already liked takes the like back off, the same as tapping the heart, and `Confirm before liking` still asks first. TikTok's default double tap still only likes, and it works for each corner with `Double tap by corner` too (#248).
- `Slide to change the hold speed` lets you pick the speed while you hold a video. Slide left or right and it steps through your own `Speed menu choices`, with a bubble near the top showing the speed. Let go and the video goes back to its usual speed, and your next hold starts at the speed you slid to. With `Lock the hold speed with a pull down` on, pulling down locks the speed you slid to, and unlocking plays your default speed when `Use a default playback speed` is on. It's off by default and sits right under `Speed while you hold the video`. The idea comes from OmerKurdi79's fork (#248).
- Liked grids get their own sort. `Sort loaded videos on Liked grids` starts at `Same as profile grids`, so nothing changes until you pick something else, and the sort button on a Liked grid now changes only the Liked order. Posts, Favorites and private videos still follow the profile setting, and other kinds of grids keep TikTok's order (#180).
- Every Hushfeed title (the settings bar, its dialogs, the Feature Gate Lab and the lock screen) now wears TikTok's cyan and red in a slow moving gradient, and it keeps moving even with Android's animations turned off.
- The Calm feed preset is gone from the top of Feed filter. The filters it used to flip are all still there, and whatever you turned on with it stays on.
- `Double tap` and `Long press` can open TikTok's search page now. It works with `Hide feed search button` on too, so you can hide the button and still get to Search (#251).
- `Fold the search into a button` puts a magnifier at the top left of the comments in place of the search box. Tap it to search, and searching (or another tap) folds the box away again. Your search keeps filtering, and the result line stays so you can tell (#254).
- `Hide the Hushfeed row` takes Hushfeed out of TikTok's Settings and privacy. Press and hold For You at the top of the feed to open the settings after that, or Home when `Long-press Home for Hushfeed settings` is on. Pausing Hushfeed brings the row back (#264).
- An @username typed into someone's bio is a link now, like the ones TikTok already links. Tap it and that profile opens. Tapping the rest of the bio still translates it, and a long press still copies it. A name right after "IG:" or "Snap" stays plain, since it belongs to another app. Turn it off with `Tap @names in bios` (#247).
- The main feed's bottom bar can be a floating glass pill now. A lens slides across the tabs as you switch, you can slide along the pill to change tabs, and haptics are optional. Interface has new settings for the blur, the glass opacity, the pill's height and its corners (#259).
- Every patch with settings now has Morphe options that pick its starting values, so a build can ship with the switches you want already on. Saved choices still win, and Reset goes back to the value you picked. Thanks to @XEGARE (#256).
- `Hide the LIVE row on Following` takes away the row of LIVE and story circles at the top of Following, along with the Story pill that opens it. The video starts right under the tabs with no empty band, and it stays that way after a swipe or Clear display. For You and the LIVE tab look the same as before (#262).
- `Skip the Share to sheet after a save` stops the Share to sheet TikTok pops up a few seconds after its own downloader saves a video. The share button works like before and the saved notice still shows.
- `Save details beside the video` covers photo posts now. Saving a post's original photos also writes one file for the whole post with its caption, creator, link and post date, plus which photos you picked and which ones saved. `Save details as JSON` works for it too. A Retry after some photos failed updates that same file instead of adding a second one, and if the file can't be written you're told separately from the photos.
- Search knows the everyday names for a few features now. Try "autoplay", "PiP", "AI" or "save photos". It also finds a choice row by any of its options, whichever one it's set to. Search "save the frame" and `Double tap` comes up, and tapping it opens its list of choices. Titles that match what you typed still come first.
- `Lock the feed at set times` locks the feed by itself during hours you pick, like `Mon-Fri 21:00-07:00; Sat Sun 13:00-15:00`. Leave the days out and it's every day, and a time that ends before it starts runs past midnight. It follows your phone's clock, daylight saving changes included. The lock panel says when it opens again, and the row shows when the next lock starts. Messages, profiles and search still work while it's on. A spent daily budget still wins, and Pause Hushfeed turns it off. Cutting hours waits a day, just like budget changes do, and you can't take hours off a day that's already locked.
- `Save only on Wi-Fi` keeps saves off mobile data. On a metered network, or when the phone can't tell, a save waits for Wi-Fi (or any network that isn't metered) for up to 30 minutes. A waiting save doesn't take one of the `Saves at once` spots, and you can cancel it from the Downloads page. Leave Wi-Fi in the middle of a save and it stops cleanly, with the finished files kept. Saving a frame still works anywhere. It's off by default.
- `Save box for chat stickers` in Downloads turns off the Save media box Hushfeed opens when you tap a sticker someone sent you in a chat. With it off, the tap only does what TikTok does (#274).
- `Let other apps play until a video starts` sits under `Mute feed videos` in Playback. With it on, opening TikTok or going back and forth to your messages doesn't pause music from another app anymore. TikTok takes the sound once a video actually plays. It's off by default (#283).
- New `Keep unsent messages` switch in Inbox. When someone unsends a message to you, it stays in the chat, and `Mark kept messages` can add "(unsent)" after it. Messages you unsend yourself still go away, and `Clear kept messages` turns the kept ones back into TikTok's usual notice. It's off by default. Thanks to @maayan080 (#291).
- `Hide the Service+ row under LIVE previews` sits with the LIVE switches in Playback. A LIVE in the feed can carry a Service+ line under the creator's name, like "Ask me anything", and this keeps it off. The line also stays with its own LIVE now. It used to hang on from the LIVE before whenever the row came back on screen, so a LIVE with no Service+ item showed the last one's. The switch is off by default (#94).
- With `Latest first on Following` on, every Following read after the first asks TikTok for 30 posts instead of its smaller count. A long list takes fewer reads, and fewer newer posts turn up after you've already scrolled past older ones (#226).
- The profile card in a LIVE room works like a profile now. Long press the bio to copy it, the name to copy the name, or the username to copy the user ID. A small copy mark after the username copies the handle with one tap (#268).
- `Hide TikTok Shop` takes the shop buttons out from under captions too, the ones that link to a product or open a shopping search with the bag icon. A plain search tag under a caption still shows (#271).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a `Notification icon` option now. Pick Hushfeed's H and TikTok's notifications show a sharp H in the status bar instead of the note. TikTok ships that note as one small picture that gets stretched on most phones, so it often looks soft. Leave the option alone and nothing changes (Discussion #114).
- `Sound format` has a third choice, MP3. Both sound saves (the one beside a video and the long-press `Save the original sound`) can come out as a plain .mp3 that plays anywhere. A sound TikTok already sent as MP3 is saved untouched, and anything else is converted on the phone at its own sample rate. MP3 works on every Android version, so the row doesn't grey out below Android 10 anymore. If a conversion fails you get the sound the way TikTok sent it (#273).
- `Also on opened videos` (under `Hide the search button on the feed`) has a `Hide the Back button there too` switch now. It also takes away the Back arrow beside that hidden search bar, so a video opened from search or a profile shows nothing at the top. Your phone's back gesture still works (#251).
- With `Block author button` on, a LIVE that shows up in For You gets the block button too. One tap blocks its host, and the feed moves on like it does after a video. The sound, feedback and mute buttons stay off LIVEs, since they don't apply there (Discussion #138).
- New `Create stickers` patch, on by default. A patched app only gets the basic comment sticker panel, which has no way to make a sticker, so its Saved page gets a Create button. Pick a photo and it shows up first in Saved a moment later, ready to send. A video's share sheet gets `Make sticker` after Download too, and that turns the video's picture into one of your saved stickers (#156, #88).
- New `Keep recent stickers` patch. The sticker panel's Recently used row stays filled after a restart or an account switch now, and your four newest show above Saved. Each account keeps its own row, and nothing is kept while you're signed out (#156).
- `Hide surveys` also hides the Not interested and Interested buttons TikTok sometimes lays over a video (#293).
- `Custom launcher icon` has a Material You style. On Android 12 and up the note and its background take colors from your wallpaper and switch with dark mode, even with themed icons off. Older phones get white on black. A new Icon background color option takes any color written like #1E88E5 and puts it behind the note, or behind your own picture, in any style (#280).
- `Leave after no touch` under Screen time is for anyone who falls asleep with the feed playing. Set it to a number of minutes and TikTok stops the video and goes to the background once nobody has touched the screen for that long, with a short message saying why. Any touch starts the wait over (a key press or a mouse wheel counts too), and so does opening a sheet like Share or the comment menu. It's off until you set it (#266).
- `Show when an account was made` puts "Joined Jan 2020" under the @username on someone else's profile, next to the follow label when that's on too. TikTok doesn't send the date, but every account's ID carries the time it was made, so it's read from there. Very old accounts from the musical.ly days have short IDs with no time in them and show nothing. The same date now fills the Joined line in Account facts when TikTok leaves it out. It's off until you turn it on.
- What's new comes in Simplified Chinese now, the way the settings already did. A phone set to Simplified Chinese gets the translated notes instead of English ones, and Traditional Chinese still gets English.
- The Feature Gate Lab has a restart button now. It shows up on the Lab page once a change needs a restart, the same as on the settings pages, and TikTok opens back on the Lab afterwards. Rules saved while overrides are off don't add to the restart count, since TikTok hasn't read them. The messages after forcing, turning off or resetting gates don't tell you to restart anymore. With overrides off there's nothing to restart for, and with them on the button is right there. Turning overrides on or off still says to restart, since that always needs one.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 1.20.0 on a computer.
- The patch bundle is signed with Morphe's own bundle signature, and the source lists the matching public key. Manager can use it to tell whether a later download really came from Hushfeed.

Fixes

- Opening a search result that lives far down a page, like `Double tap` or the Liked grid sort in Feed screen, now lands on that row. It used to open the page at its top, so you had to scroll a long way to find it.
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the "Swipe up to skip" line on a suggested account card in For You sits above the tabs again instead of behind them (#261).
- The floating tab pill is a little taller now. It reaches just above the bar and the tabs sit in its middle, so the Home icon and its name stay inside the highlight instead of poking out over it. The caption and the video's progress line move up to match, so the line no longer rides on the pill (#259).
- With `Automatic Clear display` on and no delay, opening a second video from Favorites, Likes or a profile no longer flashes TikTok's search bar at the top for a split second before it clears (#84).
- With `AMOLED dark theme` on, the activity center's card is black (or your picked color) instead of TikTok's dark gray. Those history pages are web pages inside TikTok, so the theme never reached them before (#263).
- `Hide unverified content notices` also takes the "Caution · May contain inaccurate information" strip off videos people share with you in messages. That label travels inside the message itself, so the switch didn't reach it before (#258).
- A long press on someone else's bio copies it now. Before, it only got TikTok's translate bubble, because TikTok draws other people's bios with a different part of the app than your own (#247).
- With `Open the comments at full height` on, the sheet stops below the status bar instead of running under the clock and battery icons, and the first video after opening TikTok gets the full height too instead of the usual two thirds (#261).
- Categories open and close right under their rows in the main list. Search shows the matching controls in that same list, and a category you opened stays open after you rotate the phone or restart TikTok.
- The big cards on the settings home page are a compact full-width list now, and Quick setups is gone.
- Country flags and codes stay next to names written right to left (#258).
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the name and "Tap to watch" line of LIVE previews and mini dramas stay above the tabs (#250).
- The grid sort control has a 48 dp touch target, so it's easier to hit.
- The grid sort control hides while its grid isn't showing and comes back with the grid.
- If a sort change can't be saved, the grid keeps the order it had.
- Choosing Original order keeps the current grid's sort menu available (#180).
- Comments beside the video measures its width the same way when it lays out and when it decides whether to rebuild (#253).
- In Inbox, a reused chat picture now opens the current creator's Story on the first tap when Story-first is on (#233).
- The video stays paused when a link in its comments opens another page. Leaving the tap-to-start cover for another tab keeps its feed paused too (#257).
- Notification reports in Diagnostics count how many notifications were registered and posted, and leave out what the messages said (#126, #222, #86).
- TikTok stays in the app list Android 14 and newer show when you record a single app.
- Hold a settings-search switch to reveal and highlight its control in the main list (#248).
- Startup checks record which player drew the first frame, timed with a clock that never jumps backward (#150).
- Exporting a recovered recording writes in big chunks now, so a large file doesn't take ages to save.
- Recovery Retry keeps the recording's original stop reason instead of saying TikTok closed. Recovery dialogs follow Hushfeed's theme.
- Screen recordings check storage as they run and keep recovery files until the saved copy is verified. Interrupted recordings can be retried, exported or deleted.
- The first frames of a screen recording each keep their own timestamp while the sound is starting.
- Screen recordings keep their first video frames while the sound is still starting up.
- Screen recording releases audio resources when sound can't start. Its save notice now says when the recording has no sound.
- Screen recording now asks Android to capture only the patched app's sound.
- Service+ cleanup checks the first entry in a LIVE preview now, the same one TikTok decides to show (#94).
- The comment pause can tell the first frame is playing before TikTok sends its first progress update (#151).
- `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the round Auto scroll button TikTok shows at the top right of the video on some devices (#234).
- The cover still TikTok flashes between videos grows with the picture under `See-through status bar` and `See-through bottom bar`. Only the video grew before, so every swipe showed TikTok's bands for a frame (#232).
- `Remove feed ads` also refuses the ad microseries ask for in their player. That request went around the feed ad filter, so an episode could still bring one (#286).
- Typing in a LIVE room's comment box reads light on the AMOLED dark theme. The panel went black with the rest of the room, but its text box kept TikTok's dark text and hint, so what you typed was dark on black (#267).
- `Keep a streak going` reaches names with an emoji or a space in them, and group chats. Those entries were cut at the first character a username can't hold, and the field's keyboard wouldn't even let you type them. A group is named the way your Inbox shows it, and one you haven't opened since the last restart is named in the answer so you know to open it (#289).
- Opening TikTok links from Telegram one after another no longer piles a whole For You feed under every profile. Memory stayed high and grew with each link, and Back went from feed to feed instead of out of TikTok. Now each link replaces the pages you'd opened from the last one, and Back from the profile takes you straight back to the chat you came from (#276). That holds when you open a video from the profile, share it and come back to TikTok through Recents. Back used to land on the home screen there.
- `Auto translate comments` works again on accounts TikTok moved to its newer comment list, where nothing got translated. Foreign comments switch to your language as they scroll in, and one you've flipped back with See original stays that way (#282).
- `Hide LIVE videos` catches the LIVEs TikTok slips into a For You page that's already on screen. Those used to get through because Hushfeed leaves TikTok's fresh inserts alone, and the other filters still do (#277).
- The translate icon at the top of the comments shows on while `Auto translate comments` is working, and turning it off now holds. It stays off on every video and every page you scroll to until you tap it back on or flip the switch. Before, it only reset the comments on screen, and TikTok put translation back each time the comments closed (#282).
- `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` works on a creator's profile picture too. TikTok ranks the LIVE ahead of the Story there, so the tap went into the LIVE (#233).
- Saving a video on Automatic takes the tallest copy other players can open when it's taller than TikTok's own file. TikTok's clean file is often 720p H.264 with a 1080p HEVC listed right beside it, so saves came out smaller than they had to. With the watermark kept you still get TikTok's stamped copy (#240).
- Saving a story on Automatic takes the sharpest copy the story has, the one the player shows. With `Show download progress` or a few other download switches on, it used to save a smaller 720p copy. Thanks to @jutochoppa (#287, #155).
- Recording a LIVE's screen doesn't film the Record button anymore. It hides as the recording starts and comes back once the file is saved. The recording's notification has a Stop button, and leaving the room still stops and saves it (#265).
- `Sign in without a passkey` says what to do when TikTok's 2-step check still asks only for a passkey. That page lists only the ways your account has set up, so add email or text as a way to verify on tiktok.com or another phone first, then sign in (#102).
- `Remove creation tools` never empties the face model on its own anymore, on a build with no editor and effect files, since that left face effects and Beauty unable to find a face (#285). TikTok 47.6.3's split bundle has those files again, so it now works there like it does on the universal APK and the Create tab stops working. Leave it out if you make videos.
- When TikTok turns down a like, Hushfeed tells you. The heart still fills when you tap it, but a like the server refused is gone after a restart, so the first one each session now shows TikTok's reason, or its error code when it gives none. Comment likes count too. With logging on, the diagnostics report says whether each like went through (#269).
- Videos you liked or saved stay on your Liked and Favorites grids now, even when they carry an ad, a paid partnership or a commission mark. `Remove feed ads` and the other feed filters used to take those off the grids too, so a like went through but the video never showed on Liked. The For You and Following feeds still drop them (#269).
- The Chinese message for a refused follow says 关注 now. It used to read "follow" as "the following".
- The floating tab pill blurs a LIVE preview in For You behind it too. Ordinary videos were already blurred there, but a LIVE's stream showed sharp through the glass (#259).
- Around 140 pop-up messages are shorter now, so they fit in the two lines Android 12 and later gives them. The longer ones got cut off partway through, often right where they said what to do next. For some of them the English already fit, and only the translations were trimmed.
- The Feature Gate Lab's pop-up messages fit in two lines now too, and so do the ones you get when a settings change that was cut short gets sorted out on the next launch. An import that brings in nothing new opens the same results dialog as any other import, so you can see what already matched or isn't in this TikTok version. That dialog has no Undo button, since the only thing left to undo would be the Lab change before it. Short hints like "Enter a number" no longer end in a stray full stop, in the Lab or in number fields.
- The Simplified Chinese settings read more evenly. They talk to you the same way throughout and use one word each for an account and a region. Galaxy Store and AppGallery show their real store names, and a few labels that came out wrong, like Own profile counts and Override store region, now say what they do.
- Comment search no longer undoes the keyword filter on translated comments. With both on, a translated comment the filter hid got its space in the list back every time the list drew it again. It now stays hidden whatever the search box holds.
- Picking a download folder that can't be used, like one under Music or on an SD card, opens the folder box again with the folder you picked and the reason under it. It used to be a pop-up message, and the list of allowed folders in it got cut off.

Behind the scenes

- Every LIVE preview and drama label that See-through bottom bar moves is checked against the supported TikTok APK.
- The auto-advance audit follows the video player itself instead of per-video labels. A clip that doesn't finish, or playback it can't read, leaves the check inconclusive.
- The whole-app walk checks the installed build and its patch options.
- Patch audits check the installed APK and which patches were picked. Results from another app, or from a patch left out of the build, only count as history.
- A patch audit waits for the full diagnostics report before it calls a switch missing. With no video to look at, the checks that need one stay inconclusive, and the commenter region check reads the current cache trace.
- A patch audit stops counting for a build once the code it ran against changes, and a partial rerun leaves the older checks as history.
- The patch bundle carries Gson 2.15.0, up from 2.14.0. Morphe Manager uses it while patching to read the patch defaults.
- The Licenses page under About and the NOTICE file now credit De-Vanced, where a few of the build files came from. Those files, and the telemetry patch taken from hxreborn's fork, now link the copies they were actually taken from instead of ReVanced pages that never held them.
- Releases don't carry `release-receipt-<version>.json` anymore. The bundle is byte reproducible, so you can build the tag yourself and compare the checksum.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.6.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).

What was checked

* All 143 TikTok patches applied to TikTok 47.6.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.6.3 and run on an Android emulator. A walk through the whole app opened 27 screens with no crash.
* Android's own code verifier then read every class of the patched app on that same device, and it found nothing that unpatched TikTok 47.6.3 doesn't already have.

Hushfeed v0.79.0 has 141 patches. 140 of them are for global TikTok 47.5.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`), and 95 work on PineDrama 47.5.3, one of those made just for it. It needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 2.0.0.

TikTok stays on 47.5.3, so the TikTok APK you already have is fine to patch again. PineDrama moves to 47.5.3, so grab that one from APKMirror before you patch it. PineDrama got a lot of attention in this one. Six more patches run on it, and photo comments and imported fonts work there now. On TikTok there's a spam comment filter and a way to record a LIVE straight off the screen, and `Hide videos you have already seen` keeps watched videos out of For You again.

Here's every report this release changed something for, and what changed.

For bug reports

* Repeats in For You (#172). `Hide videos you have already seen` checks each new For You page once TikTok hands it over, so videos you watched stop coming back.
* The comment bar on photo posts (#171). With `AMOLED dark theme`, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post is black instead of letting the photo show through.
* Fonts on PineDrama (#243). `Use an imported font` now draws PineDrama's text in your font, and bold text stays bold.
* Missing saved stickers (#214). PineDrama's sticker panel loads every sticker you saved. It used to stop at 100.
* Low download quality (#240). When the quality list stops below 720p, it also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC file if that one is taller, and the diagnostic report shows why each quality was or wasn't offered.
* Commenter countries (#201). `Show where commenters are from` remembers people's countries from their earlier comments and videos, so it finds one more often.
* Running out of memory while patching (#220). The README says to give morphe-desktop 2 GB with `java -Xmx2g`.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). A search result you open again clears again, even if you brought its buttons back by hand last time.

For feature requests

* PineDrama (#156). It moves to 47.5.3, six more patches run on it, and a new `Allow photo comments` patch lets the comment box ask TikTok's server about photo comments like TikTok does. Hushfeed's settings also say to restart PineDrama now, not TikTok.
* A spam shield for comments (#187). `Hide spam comments` hides the bots that point you to their bio or hand out a contact, and leaves the creator's own comments alone.
* Effects that refuse older phones (#176). `Report a newer phone to effects` tells the effects server you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra.
* Saving LIVEs (#37). `LIVE recording source` can record the screen as you watch, and Share > Video quality now shows in gaming and football rooms too.
* LIVE recording presets (#203). `LIVE recording quality` offers Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p and takes a room's 60 fps stream when it has one. You can change it from a LIVE room's Share sheet too.
* The liquid glass bar (#231). `Blur the video behind the bar` frosts the pill with the video under it, and the lens slides between tabs every time now.
* Dark LIVE rooms (#159). The light bits left in rooms turn dark, from the profile card's tiles to the menu's navigation bar, and a room stays dark when your phone switches themes.
* The Auto scroll switch on foldables (#234). `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` hides the switch beside the avatar too, with or without Auto-advance.
* OmerKurdi79's batch (#232). Clear display lets go with your swipe, and the See-through bottom bar no longer drops the caption over the tabs after each swipe.
* An instant pause (#239). With double tap set to do nothing, a tap pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts.
* Latest on Following (#226). `Latest first` keeps everything below your video in date order as posts load, and the tab starts on the newest post.
* Better sorting (#180). Profile grids get Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid loads up to 300 videos by itself, and swiping through them keeps that order.
* Stories from LIVE creators (#233). `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE` opens their Story from their profile picture or your chat with them, and the next tap joins the LIVE.
* LIVE quality in dark mode (#57). The newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable on dark mode.
* Add to Story (#88). `Allow Add to Story anyway` brings the button back when a creator turned off content reuse.
* Time zones (#184, #198). With `Match locale and timezone` on, chat dates follow the preset's zone.
* Thoughts (#186). `Turn on Thoughts` shows Thoughts for accounts TikTok left out.
* Original image formats (#229). Stickers that don't move are saved as TikTok sent them too.
* Camera brightness (#200). `Keep the screen's brightness in the camera` also covers the front flash and the fill light.

That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).

PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". HushMessenger for Messenger 585.0.0.53.94, all 7 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. 71 patches. The bundle is signed now, and new switches save the voice messages you play, put gallery picks straight into the chat and let calls from chosen people come in without a ring. Material You takes your own colors, and the settings speak Vietnamese. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Quiet incoming calls` has a new **Only chosen chats** switch under it. Turn it on, then pick from the people who called you lately (they're listed newest first), and only their calls come in without a ring. Everyone else rings as usual. Refs #117.
- `Android Auto messages` is a new switch under Conversations. Android Auto only reads a message out and takes a spoken reply when the notification has a mark-as-read action, and Messenger's don't, so Auto fell back to treating them as plain alerts. With the switch on, each message notification carries Messenger's own car mark-as-read as an action you never see on the phone, right next to Messenger's Reply. Android Auto only lists apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #75.
- `Hide the Instants button` is a new switch under Inbox. It hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and opens Instants, on every 585 build. Not every account gets that button, so the switch is experimental. Refs #118.
- `Hide the Instants button` also covers the Instants button under your chat heads, the one that sits right where your thumb goes when you reach for a chat. Refs #104.
- `Save voice messages you play` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Each voice message you play also lands in Recordings/Messenger on your phone (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so a file manager or another player can open it later. Playing the same one again doesn't make a second copy. It needs Android 10 or newer and starts off. Refs #90.
- `Put gallery picks in the chat` is a new switch under Photos and videos that goes with `Open your gallery app`. What you pick in your gallery app goes straight into the chat you came from, above the message box, instead of Messenger's editor or the Send to sheet. Pick one photo or a dozen, then tap Send when you're ready. Nothing goes out on its own. It also brings that row above the message box to accounts where Messenger hadn't turned it on yet. A chat that was already open when you flipped the switch needs opening again. Starts off. Refs #101.
- HushMessenger's settings speak Vietnamese when your phone is set to it, in any region. Thanks to @hautv404 for the translation. Refs #113.
- **GmsCore support** is a new patch that starts unselected, for phones running microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Messenger asks microG-RE for its push token, so it can stay signed in. It's experimental. Leave it out on a phone with Play services. Refs #119.
- Material You can use your own colors now. Under Appearance, copy a theme like `{"name": "Sunset", "accent": "#E1306C", "neutral": "#1A1418", "pure_black": true}` and tap **Use copied theme**. The accent replaces Messenger's blues and the neutral tints its grays and backgrounds in dark mode, at Messenger's own brightness so text stays readable. **Copy theme** hands you the colors in use to tweak or share, and **Back to wallpaper colors** drops it. Refs #115.
- `Keep a message log` marks a message Unsent when the sender takes it back, encrypted chats included, and the log page has a **Show only unsent** button for finding them. With `Keep unsent messages` on, it also tries to keep an unsent message's notification up, even when it was the only message the notification showed, since an encrypted chat can't keep the message on screen. That notification part is experimental. Refs #70.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager 2.3 and newer checks the signature inside the `.mpp` before it loads HushMessenger, and once it has seen this key it won't take a bundle signed with another one. Manager shows the key as `4d8d c2b3 fbcd 3ab6`, and the README has a command for checking a download by hand. Older Managers don't look at it.

### Fixes and changes

- On a Samsung phone, `Bold and italic text` now tells you where to switch Bold and Italic on. Samsung keeps other apps' entries out of the text menu until you tick them under the three dots and Manage apps, so turning on the switch alone looked like it did nothing. Refs #42.
- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a login that gets past the password and then loops on a browser check. That's an account with a passkey, and removing the passkey on the web lets Facebook fall back to approving the login from another device. Refs #108.
- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 and takes all 7 builds APKMirror lists for it, five for arm64 and two for armv7. 584.1.0.61.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them.
- `Hide Facebook shortcuts` now also hides the View profile button under the person's name and picture at the top of a chat with no messages yet. It opened their Facebook profile. With `Keep the Profile button` on, that one stays too.
- `Hide inbox tabs` now says what it hides on 585: the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. The old text named Home and Channels tabs Messenger doesn't show anymore. Checked on 585, where On hides the tabs and Off or Pause brings them back.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video you pick in Google Photos that's already saved on your phone now reaches Messenger as the phone's own copy, which Messenger reads with its own photo and video access. Before, the upload had to go through Google Photos' permission. Items that only live in the cloud, and anything Messenger can't open itself, go through as picked. Refs #103.
- Opening a new issue on GitHub now offers a bug report form and a feature request form. The bug form asks for your versions, how you got your patched Messenger (Morphe Manager, Morphe Desktop, morphe-cli or a prebuilt APK), which patches source you added, the phone and where in Messenger it happened, so a report can be looked into without a round of questions first. Other sources carry HushMessenger's patches built from other code, and the source address tells them apart. **App > Report a problem** still opens a blank issue with those facts already filled in.
- The README's Install step says what Manager 2.3 and newer shows as this project's signing key, and its Help section explains the "Key changed" badge. It means the bundle was signed with another key and came from somewhere other than this source, so remove that source and add this one again instead of tapping Trust.
- The README's Help section explains why videos can go missing from Messenger's own picker on Android 14 and newer: with Messenger's photo access set to "Allow limited access" the picker shows only the items you chose. "Allow all" or `Open your gallery app` brings them back. Refs #114.
- With `Square profile pictures` on, the story ring around a picture in your chat list is square too, or rounded with **Round the corners**, so it hugs the picture instead of circling it. A ring that's still filling in follows the same edge. The ring part is experimental. Refs #116.
- `Hide stories and notes` also takes away the story rings around people's pictures in your chat list, the colored circle that says someone posted. It works with or without `Square profile pictures`, and like the square ring it's experimental. Refs #118.
- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, the patcher that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, or Desktop to 1.20.0, before you add this release.

### Behind the scenes

- The release check reads the bug form's version placeholder and refuses a release where it names another HushMessenger version or a Messenger build the bundle doesn't target. Prepare moves it along with the README.
- The release check reads which patcher built the bundle from its manifest and wants the README to ask for the first Morphe Manager and Morphe Desktop that come with it. Install steps can't send anyone to a Manager too old to load the release. Between releases the README keeps naming what the published release needs.
- The release check refuses a bundle holding a class file compiled for anything newer than Java 17 and names the entry, since morphe-patcher 2.1 won't load one. Entries under `META-INF/versions/` are left alone, as the patcher leaves them.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now patches the stock APK of the build the device already runs when you don't pass `-Apk`. It reads the installed version code and picks that build from `HUSH_NATIVE_FIXTURES`, so the install no longer dies on `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` or lands a different ABI or screen density. When no fixture is that build, it stops and says which builds it has.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now waits up to 90 seconds after it installs Messenger, until the chat list or the restore prompt shows. The first start after an update upgrades Messenger's data, and until that's done a chat link opens a blank screen. On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 585.0.0.53.94 first. Any build on [APKMirror's 585.0.0.53.94 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-585-0-0-53-94-release/) works, and a `nodpi` one keeps the icons sharp.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.3.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **71 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.28.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 7 Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

HushMessenger 0.27.0 moves to Messenger 584.1.0.61.98 and works with every arm64 and armv7 build APKMirror has for it. Log out is back on the App tab, and new switches give you square profile pictures and keep Your story out of the share list.There's also an optional white on black launcher icon. The settings got a cleaner layout with folding sections, and a clone install no longer crashes when the regular Messenger is on the same phone.

You'll need Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer.

### New in this release

- **Log out** is back. It's a row on the App page of the HushMessenger settings, and tapping it signs you out of the account on this phone the same way Messenger's own Log out does. You end up on Messenger's login screen, ready for the same account or a different one. There's no extra "are you sure" step. If a Messenger build ever moves its Log out, the row says so and points you to the one in Messenger's menu. Refs #88.
- **Square profile pictures** is a new switch under Theme, and it starts off. After a restart, profile pictures in the chat list, the stories row, chat headers and suggestions turn into squares, or rounded squares if you also turn on **Round the corners**. People who are online, the ones with the green dot, keep the same size as everyone else in the stories row. Notification pictures stay round. Refs #89.
- **Custom launcher icon** is a new patch that starts unselected. It turns Messenger's home screen icon white on black, or black on white if you pick that style, using Messenger's own logo. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work. Patch again without it to get the normal icon back. Refs #107.
- HushMessenger's settings speak Traditional Chinese when your phone is set to it, in Taiwan, Hong Kong or Macau. Simplified Chinese still shows English for now. Thanks to @JhouHank for the translation. Refs #98.
- **Hide Your story when sharing** is a new switch under Photos and videos, and it starts off. Share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app and the Send to list won't offer Your story anymore, so a stray tap on Add can't post it. Your chats and groups stay right where they were, and the story itself works as usual. Refs #102.

### Fixes and changes

- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 584.1.0.61.98 and takes all 21 builds APKMirror lists for it, arm64 and armv7 alike, including the three arm64 bundles `346817008`, `346817025` and `346817026`. 584.0.0.49.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them. Refs #106.
- Patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.0.1, which uses less memory while patching. You'll need Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer, or Morphe Desktop 1.19.1.
- The HushMessenger settings got a tighter layout, modeled on HushFacebook's. Every section folds up under its own header and starts closed, so the whole list fits on a couple of screens. Open the ones you use and they stay open next time. Searching still finds any control, whether its section is open or not. The banner with "Make Messenger yours" and the Inbox, Chats and More chips are gone. The colors now follow Messenger's own blue in both the light and dark theme, and Restart Messenger sits at the top of the App tab.
- Every HushMessenger title (the settings name, the sheet titles and the restart screen) now shows Messenger's blue to purple to pink to orange colors. They drift slowly with a light sheen now and then, and they keep moving even with Android's animations turned off.
- TalkBack reads each settings section's open or closed state once now. It used to say it twice, like "collapsed, Collapsed, Inbox".
- With large text, the little arrow on each settings section shows whole again. At 200% it was cut down to a sliver.
- **Source and licenses** under About opens the README's Credits section again. It pointed at a heading the README no longer has, so it landed at the top of the page.
- With **Open your gallery app** on and no default gallery set, the list Android shows you now holds only your gallery apps. It could slip in other pickers, like Contacts. Whichever gallery you tap still opens with your photos and videos together. Refs #94.
- If Messenger crashed in the last three days, **Report a problem** now adds a line saying where in the code it happened. It's only the names of the failing code, never the error text, so no file names or chat content go in. Refs #103.
- Checking what you picked from your gallery no longer holds up Messenger's screen. If you cancel, or the pick times out or loses its permission, you're back in the chat with nothing attached. Report a problem now notes how the last gallery pick ended, without any file names. Refs #94.
- The patch log now shows when each search through Messenger's code starts and finishes. The Wi-Fi search is faster and lighter on memory too, since it reads Messenger's code directly instead of building text for every reference it passes. Refs #93, #99, #100.
- In **Auto reply**, a picture always lands on the card you picked it for, and it's always the one you picked last. Before, a slow copy of an earlier pick could finish late and replace the newer picture, or put one back after you tapped Clear. Save waits while a picture is still copying.
- Picking a picture for an auto reply is safer with huge or slow files. HushMessenger reads the file once into its own copy, turns away files over 32 MB or 64 megapixels, and gives up after 30 seconds, then tells you which of those happened. Picking again or tapping Clear stops the earlier copy right away, and the picture you had before stays put.
- Some APKMirror downloads of Messenger only carry icons for one small screen size, so on a sharper phone the launcher icon and the icons in Messenger's settings look blurry and jagged. HushMessenger's settings now say so under About when your download is one of those, and the README lists which builds have icons for every screen. Patching a `nodpi` build fixes it. Refs #91.
- **Hide Meta AI** now reaches the search screen too. Tap the search bar and the box at the top used to say "Ask Meta AI or search" even with the switch on. Now it shows the plain search hint, like the bar on the Chats list. Search still finds people and chats the same way.
- **Clone install under another package name** no longer crashes a few seconds after you open the copy when the regular Messenger is on the phone too. The copy was saving its muted chats into the other Messenger's storage, which Android blocks, so now it keeps them in its own.
- With **Slide chats in and out** on, a chat whose first frames come late no longer jumps partway in. That happened most on the first chat you open after starting Messenger. The chat now waits off screen until Messenger draws on time (a quarter second at most), then slides in from the edge. Going back works the same way.

### Behind the scenes

- The install check now names the kind of refusal it finds and what to do about it. A Messenger signed with another key says which Android user it's installed for, so a copy hiding in Secure Folder or a work profile is easy to find. A permission held by another app (`INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`) is no longer mixed up with a Messenger signer problem.
- The README's settings screenshots are new, and they now show the App tab too. They're rendered from the settings code, with a small record of which switches they show and each image's checksum. A release stops when a switch was added, renamed or retired since then, or when an image no longer matches. Any link from the app into the README has to reach a heading that exists.
- When another app takes the phone's screen in the middle of a walk, the failed step now says which app it was, instead of only saying it left no screen dump.
- The whole-app walk now has to show every screen it opened. Counting them is no longer enough. Each required step (a chat, both settings tabs, the message log and auto reply sheets when those patches are in, and each native screen) saves a screenshot and a UI dump next to the receipt, with their checksums. Publish reads those files again and refuses the walk when a step is missing or listed twice, a file is missing or changed, a screen shows the Restore or login prompt, two steps landed on the same screen, or a step ended up somewhere it shouldn't. An older receipt that only counted screens doesn't count anymore.
- Every Messenger screen in the walk now has to land on its own page. Any Messenger screen no longer passes. Each step checks the page it lands on and a label only that page has, so a link that drops back to the inbox fails. Messenger 584.1 ignores most of its old links when another app sends them (the inbox, Active now, stories, new message, stickers and Marketplace). The walk now opens the inbox from Messenger's own launcher and adds the story and contact settings pages, which still open by link.
- On Android 12 and older the walk can now pass the message log. Before Android 13 the log blocks screenshots to keep chat text out of Recents, so that one step keeps a record showing its window is locked instead. Every other step still needs its screenshot.

- [#85](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/85) New **Hide the recent photo card** switch under Photos and videos. Anything you took is still in the gallery button when you want to send it. It starts off.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) With two gallery apps on the phone and neither set as the default, **Open your gallery app** sent you to a Samsung Gallery that listed photos only. - [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) and [#82](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/82) **Open your gallery app** lets you pick several photos and videos at once. The text goes out first and the picture follows a couple of seconds later in the same chat, with the same once-per-chat wait, Off and Pause as the text. HushMessenger keeps its own copy of the picture, so moving or deleting the original won't break the reply. If that copy is gone, or a Messenger update changed how photos are sent, the text still goes out on its own.

### Changed and fixed

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 584.0.0.49.98 (version code 346814894) and no longer takes 583.0.0.29.95. That's the one arm64 build of 584 on [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-584-0-0-49-98-release/) so far. Every switch was checked against it again, so update Messenger to 584 before you repatch.
- **Hide inbox ads** is gone. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, and Messenger 584 took out the ad cards the switch used to filter, so there's nothing left for it to hide. If you pick patches by hand in Morphe, it just won't be in the list anymore.
- The six photo and video switches now have their own **Photos and videos** group, in Morphe's patch list and on the settings Controls tab alike: original quality photos and videos, **Fix videos that won't send**, the camera and gallery app switches, and **Hide the recent photo card**. Conversations had grown too long to scan. The Chats filter still shows them.
- **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** now stay at the top of the icon's long-press menu while Messenger sits in the background. New messages used to push them below the four rows your launcher shows until you next opened and left Messenger. Android 9 and 10 still put them back only when Messenger opens or closes.
- Hiding Quick setups with a long press now names the button that brings it back, **Quick setups section** under Your choices. The old message sent you to the App tab you were already on, and the button talked about a home page that doesn't exist.
- A video picked in a chat whose access ran out before or during the send no longer gets **Fix videos that won't send** marked as failing in settings. It goes out the way Messenger would send it anyway.
- If the phone's sound encoder won't start while a video's sound is being fixed, it's let go right away instead of staying held until Messenger closes.
- The copies **Fix videos that won't send** makes of videos you pick now go a day after their last use, even if you never pick another video or you've turned the switch off. Messenger clears them when it starts and again while it's open as each one's day runs out. They used to sit in Messenger's cache until the next pick.
- Android 12 and newer show only two lines of a pop-up message and cut the rest with "...", which hid the useful part of 27 of HushMessenger's. They're shorter now and fit, from the font file and backup messages to the camera, gallery and restart ones.
- Restoring your choices pops up how many of them it actually changed ("Changed 3 of 58 choices"), that none changed, or that they already match the backup, plus "Changes paused" or "Changes resumed" when the backup pauses or unpauses them. It used to count every choice in the backup, even ones that were already set that way, and the pause along with them. It only says they match when nothing in the backup was skipped or left off. Skipped choices and Auto reply staying off used to run past the end of that message. Now the whole result stays written under the backup buttons.
- When reading a choices file takes too long, the message says your choices didn't change. It used to warn that a saved file may be cut off, which is only true when saving one.
- If settings can't open from the side menu or the Messenger logo, two short messages now say so and then name the other way in. One message was too long and lost its second half.
- Picking a font file while **Use your own font** is off now says to turn the switch on, instead of telling you to restart Messenger. The file's name stays on the line under the button, where a long one can't push the rest off the message.
- **Use system emoji** loads the phone's emoji font once, even when Messenger asks for it from several threads at the same moment. Each thread could load its own copy before.
- When the message log can't save new messages (the phone's key store is busy, say), it tries again by itself 30 seconds later, then less often while it keeps failing. Those messages used to wait for the next notification and were lost if Messenger closed first.
- **Back to defaults**, the other Quick setups and **Clear log** each show an Undo button at the top of settings for about 10 seconds, and the emptied log shows one too. Clear log still deletes the saved messages and their key right away. Undo writes them back from a copy kept in memory until the button goes, and leaving settings makes the change final. Undo leaves alone any switch you flipped yourself after the change.
- The **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** long-press shortcuts now tell your launcher when you use them, so it can rank them by use the way it does Messenger's own chat shortcuts.
- On a Root Mount install, **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** never actually showed up on Messenger's icon. Android turned down the icons they used. They show up now.
- Each way back into settings now has its own switch on the App tab, as asked in [HushFacebook#146](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook/issues/146). Next to **Hide the Menu row** there's **Hide the icon shortcuts**, which takes **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** off the menu you get by long-pressing Messenger's home screen icon, and **Ignore the logo long press**. The last way in that's still on can't be switched off: its switch goes gray and says why, and if a saved choice leaves nothing else, the icon shortcuts come back by themselves. Pause and safe mode leave these switches alone, since they're how you get back in to undo either. If the logo long press is what lets the Menu row stay hidden, the row comes back after an update or a repatch until one long press on the logo opens settings again.
- The two icon shortcuts now come from HushMessenger each time Messenger starts, on every install, which is what lets the new switch take them away. After updating, they show up again a moment after you first open Messenger. Messenger's own chat shortcuts can push them down that menu while it's open, so they move back to the top each time you leave Messenger. On a normal install, a copy you pinned to the home screen before this update stops working, so remove it and pin a new one. Copies pinned from now on turn gray while the shortcuts are hidden and work again once they're back.
- When Messenger's chat shortcuts already fill everything Android lets one icon hold, the lowest of them now make room, so **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** still get on. Android refused to add them to a full icon before. Those are the same chat shortcuts Android drops when Messenger adds one to a full icon itself.
- In the settings cards, the line between switches now sits below a switch's own buttons (Keep the Profile button, the bubble choices, the font file, message log and auto reply buttons) instead of between the switch and them. The last switch in a card no longer draws a second line just above the card's edge.
- With a keyboard or a remote, the focus outline on a filled settings button (Restart Messenger, Save, the selected tab and filter) is now two rings, a dark and a light one, so it shows up against the button and the page in both themes. The single gray ring was hard to see on the button's own color.
- The settings call each thing by one name now. Controls are the switches, and your choices are what you set them to. The clipboard backup buttons are **Copy choices** and **Paste choices**, since Export and Import sat right next to the file buttons and sounded like them. The third bubble mode is **Android bubbles**, which is what Android calls them. Flipping a control pops up "Hide stories and notes is on" instead of "Hide stories and notes on", and **Fix videos that won't send** says what it does before it names the sound format.
- Two patches got plainer names, in Morphe's patch list and in settings. **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is now **Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages**, and **Stop MQTT logging** is now **Stop live connection logging**. Morphe remembers your picks by name, so if you'd left either one out, it'll be picked again. Uncheck it before you repatch.
- With **Hide People tab**, **Hide Notifications tab** or **Hide Meta AI** on, the bar at the bottom now lights up the tab you're actually on. With People hidden, opening Notifications used to light up Menu instead.
- Some accounts get Meta's newer AI agent tab in the bar where the Meta AI tab usually sits. **Hide Meta AI** now hides that one too, and the bar still lights up the right tab. Restart Messenger to see it go.
- On a new install of a patched Messenger, **Bold** and **Italic** no longer show up in the text selection menu while **Bold and italic text** is off. Messenger's very first start turned them on, and they stayed there until you opened Messenger a second time. Updating over an existing install never did this.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** now hides the plain **Generate** button at the start of the sticker keyboard's Suggested row too. Accounts that get more than one sticker maker see that button instead of **Generate AI stickers**, and it opens a menu with AI stickers in it, so the switch used to miss it. The custom and music stickers in that menu are hidden along with it while the switch is on.
- With **Hide AI sticker tools** on, the rest of the Suggested row now moves up to fill the spot where **Generate** or **Generate AI stickers** used to sit. The button went away before, but its slot at the start of the row stayed blank.
- HushMessenger is now built for Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then repatch. Every patch still applies to Messenger 584 and the patch count is the same.

### Docs

- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a cloned Messenger showing the settings icon again, chats and calls notifying twice because of the Facebook app, and restoring chats with a PIN when the Google Drive restore errors out.

### Checks

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Messenger crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Messenger from the bundle, installs it in place on a leased phone or an emulator, opens both settings pages, a chat and the patched screens, then reads the crash buffer and writes the receipt publish asks for. Any Messenger crash fails the walk. Leaving out a page or a screen makes it partial, and neither one backs a release. The receipt also names the APK patched from the bundle and the one the phone actually ran, and publish wants them to match, so walking whatever was already installed (`-SkipPatch`) only counts when it's that same APK. A crash buffer the walk can't read fails it, and the script exits 0 only for a pass (2 for partial, 1 for a fail). A walk that finds the device busy keeps the APK it patched, so the next try goes straight to the device instead of patching again.
- The development release check, the one a held build goes through, fails when the source has no bundle timestamp. Before, a bundle and a source both missing one counted as a match there. The full release check already refused it, and now it says why.
- A Gradle run through this PC's build wrapper fails when the wrapper itself errors out before Gradle starts. It used to exit 0 and read as a pass.
- Recording a Messenger build with `CompatReport.java --save` refuses an APK that isn't signed by Facebook or Meta, or whose signer apksigner can't read. A record pins the APK's checksum, so a re-signed copy could have been written down as the stock build. The release build stage also checks each stock APK against the checksum in its record before patching it, and CompatReport looks for Python as `py`, `python3` or `python` (never the Windows Store stub) instead of assuming `python`.
