### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* support OpenBubbles build 20002293 ([2499479](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/commit/2499479cb39d4b88e86e87831e85fe82c6b77f52))

## OpenBubbles compatibility

The OpenBubbles patches require **2.0.0, build 20002293, ARM64**. The version name alone does not identify the required build. The supplied single phone APK uses the existing OpenBubbles Wear signing key and updates the prior patched universal APK in place. Preserve the existing installation and app data; a stock installation uses a different signing key.

The update passed patch, integration, native linkage, Android runtime, signature, alignment, and in-place upgrade checks. The user confirmed it is working after updating the validation relay. The watch application is unchanged.

## Original OpenBubbles input for Morphe

Download [the original ARM64 split archive](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/releases/download/v1.3.1/OpenBubbles-2.0.0-20002293-original-arm64.apks), then select it in Morphe as an existing APK file. It contains the original base, ARM64, English, and xxhdpi splits from OpenBubbles 2.0.0 (version code 20002293). Morphe merges the splits while patching. Its download flow does not currently support a custom APK URL supplied by a patch bundle, so select this file manually.



SHA-256: archive `b48adb5fd1ad9d29ac00ab429efb388244c1270671e690c1f3d29c5076454280`. Morphe must sign the patched output with the existing installation's key to update it in place.

## Installing updates without losing data

Android requires the installed app and its update to be signed with the same key. The pre-patched phone APK is signed with the OpenBubbles Wear release key and can update an existing APK signed with that key. Morphe signs its output with the key configured in Morphe; its output and the pre-patched APK can update one another only when that configured key matches the existing installation. A default Morphe key, another person's key, and the stock Play Store key cannot update an installation signed with a different key. Do not uninstall or clear app data to work around a signature mismatch as you will most likely be rate limited again.

This is the first HushPine release, with 97 patches for PineDrama 47.5.3. These patches used to ship inside Hushfeed's bundle. They're their own project now, and Hushfeed is going back to TikTok only, so its next release won't include PineDrama.

If you patched PineDrama with Hushfeed, add HushPine as a source in Morphe Manager and patch again with the same signing key. Your login and settings come along.

## What's changed

* HushPine starts here. The PineDrama patches used to ship inside Hushfeed's bundle, and they now live in their own repo with their own bundle and signing key. Your settings and saved data carry over when you move from Hushfeed's patches.
* Press and hold any tab at the top of the feed to open HushPine's settings. It used to work on one tab only, and PineDrama's server decides which middle tab you get, so the shortcut could disappear.
* Latest first on Following now leaves alone what you've already scrolled past. It used to reorder the whole list each time PineDrama read it.
* New saves go to `DCIM/PineDrama` by default instead of `DCIM/TikTok`. A folder you picked yourself stays as it is, and files you've already saved don't move.
* Settings no longer describe buttons and rows PineDrama doesn't have. The story save rows are gone, and so are the Balance and TikTok Minis rows for the profile menu, since PineDrama's gear goes straight to Settings and privacy.

## Update

Refresh the HushPine source in Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer and patch PineDrama again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK.

## Checked

* All 97 PineDrama patches applied to PineDrama 47.5.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto PineDrama 47.5.3 and run on a signed-in Galaxy S22. A walk through the whole app opened 26 screens with no crash.
* Installed over a PineDrama patched with Hushfeed's bundle on the same phone. The login and settings stayed.
* Pressing and holding Following or Drama opened HushPine's settings on this build.
* With Latest first on Following turned on, swiping the Following feed went from a 10-23 post to 10-15 and then 09-29.
* Copy link gave a plain tiktok.com link with the tracking removed.
* The Downloads section shows DCIM/PineDrama as the save folder.

## Apple Music DiLink 1.0.8

Corrige a seleção do impl do `WindowInsetsCompat` em API 29. O guard injetado usava
`if-ge` em vez de `if-lt`, então o app instanciava `x2/V$i` (Impl30) e crashava em
`WindowInsets.Type.captionBar()` dentro do tema do onboarding.

- `WindowInsetsCompat` passa a usar o impl de API 20 abaixo de 30;
- o provider MediaRouter2 não é criado abaixo de API 30 (mesma inversão);
- o guard do `FullScreenVideoActivity` também foi corrigido.

Mantém as correções da 1.0.7 e o TLS/acessibilidade da 1.0.4.

**Em validação no DiLink.**

## Apple Music DiLink 1.0.6

Corrige o crash de launch restante na 1.0.5 no DiLink (Android 10):

- `ViewCompat.setWindowInsetsAnimationCallback` (`x2/E.m`) construía o adaptador
  `x2/U$c$a`, que estende `android.view.WindowInsetsAnimation.Callback` (API 30). A classe era
  carregada mesmo com a chamada de plataforma já redirecionada; a construção foi neutralizada.
- `android.os.ext.SdkExtensions.getExtensionVersion` (API 30, 16 call sites) passa a devolver 0
  em API 29.

Mantém as correções de runtime da 1.0.5 e o TLS/acessibilidade da 1.0.4.

## v2.2.2 — Universal patches: optimized & easier to use

All 24 universal patches now share a single optimization layer:

* `UniversalUtils.kt` — single-pass manifest DOM traversal, tolerant list parsing (`parseTokens` + `RELAXED_LIST_VALIDATOR`), consistent `[Proteus/Universal]` logging and a `guarded()` fail-safe wrapper.
* Six manifest patches refactored to one DOM pass; every universal patch now emits the shared log prefix.

### `Remove dangerous permissions` (main usability target)
* Replaced the one long comma-separated option with **16 category switches** (package visibility, phone, accounts, location, contacts, mic, camera, storage, SMS, calendar, sensors, nearby devices, screen-capture detection, ad ID, AdServices, notifications).
* **All categories ON by default** (aggressive), as selected. The patch remains off by default.
* New `Permissions to keep` and `Extra permissions to remove` lists, plus a legacy `Advanced: exact removal list` override for existing configs.
* AdServices is now a toggle instead of an unconditional removal.

Assets:
* `patches-2.2.2.mpp` — Morphe patch bundle.
* `proteus-universal-2.2.2.zip` — universal patch sources + updated audit.

`patches-list.json` and README were regenerated from source by CI for this release. Aggressive defaults can break camera, storage, notifications or SMS features; use the keep-list or category switches to exempt them.

## v2.2.1 — Content filters fingerprint fix

Fixes the `Failed to match the fingerprint ... <clinit>` crash reported on Reddit 2026.42.0 / Patcher 2.2.0 / Manager 2.4.0.

D8 encodes a `static final` String initializer as a DEX static-field value and removes the `<clinit>` `const-string`, so the old `<clinit>` fingerprint had no instruction to match. The helper now returns the placeholder from `patchConfig()`, and the patch rewrites every matching `const-string` directly (the same mechanism as `replaceStringPatch`). The helper also no-ops any value without five pipe-separated fields, so the unpatched placeholder is still safe.

Assets:
* `patches-2.2.1.mpp` — Morphe patch bundle.
* `proteus-reddit-patches-2.2.1.zip` — the new patch sources and extension helper.

Both Reddit patches remain off by default; configure the content-filter options at patch time. Server-side Reddit filters still cannot be bypassed.

New opt-in patches for `com.reddit.frontpage`:

* **Block AutoMod comments** — hides every u/AutoModerator comment (including stickied ones), keeps AutoModerator posts.
* **Content filters** — patch-time keyword / community / author / flair filters plus a local bypass for NSFW / spoiler / quarantine gates and over-18 account flags.

Server-side Reddit filters cannot be bypassed. Both patches are off by default; configure the content-filter options at patch time.

## [1.2.0](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New features

* **SOCKS5 proxy support.** You can now route the app through a SOCKS5 proxy, as well as HTTP and HTTPS proxies.
  * Optional username and password (standard SOCKS5 username/password login).
  * **DNS stays on the proxy.** Website names are sent to the SOCKS5 server unresolved, so your phone never looks up the sites the app visits.
  * Only TCP is used. That's all the app needs, because QUIC/UDP is already off whenever a proxy is set.
* **Proxy type setting.** The old "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" on/off switch is replaced by a three-way choice: **HTTPS** (encrypted connection to the proxy), **HTTP** (plain) or **SOCKS5**.
  * **In the app:** long-press the Reddit icon → **Proxy settings** → Proxy type.
  * **In Morphe Manager:** a **Proxy type** dropdown in the patch options.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Test connection understands SOCKS5** and explains what's wrong in plain words:
  * wrong username or password;
  * the proxy needs a login;
  * the server isn't a SOCKS5 proxy;
  * the proxy couldn't reach the website (network unreachable, host unreachable, connection refused, and so on).
* **More reliable with SOCKS5 servers that have broken IPv6.** Some servers look up a website's IPv6 address even though they can't actually use IPv6, then answer "host unreachable". This makes images and videos fail at random. The app now retries those connections automatically (twice), and logs each retry. If it keeps happening, the error message suggests setting the server to prefer IPv4, which is the proper fix.
* **Your settings carry over.** If you're updating from 1.1.0 and set "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" on or off in the app, it's kept as **HTTPS** or **HTTP**.

### ⚠️ Things to know

* **SOCKS5 isn't encrypted** between your phone and the proxy. Your app traffic inside the tunnel is still HTTPS, but your proxy login and the names of the sites you visit can be seen on the network path. If that matters to you, use an **HTTPS** proxy, which protects both. The settings screen labels SOCKS5 as "(not encrypted)".
* **The "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" patch option is replaced by "Proxy type".** If you set that option in Morphe Manager (rather than in the app), check it the next time you patch. It defaults to HTTPS. Proxy settings saved inside the app aren't affected.

### ✅ Tested

Tested with Reddit 2026.40.0 on an Android 15 emulator, watching every connection the app made:

* **SOCKS5** with a real SOCKS5 server and with a local test server:
  * the feed, images and video load through the proxy, with nothing going direct;
  * all destinations were sent to the proxy by name, with no lookups on the device;
  * a wrong password gives a clear error.
* **HTTPS** proxy re-tested after the change, with everything going through the proxy and no errors.
* **"Run without proxy"** and the leak fixes from 1.1.0 are unchanged.

## [1.1.0](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-04)

### 🔒 Leak fixes
* **No more direct connections when the proxy fails.** Android's built-in `HttpURLConnection` quietly fell back to a direct connection whenever the proxy failed: when none was set, it was down, or it rejected the login. That let SDKs such as AppsFlyer and Firebase logging connect without the proxy. Every connection now goes through the proxy, or doesn't happen at all.

### ✨ New features
* **Change your proxy any time, without repatching.** Long-press the Reddit icon → **Proxy settings** to set the host, port, HTTPS/TLS, username and password. Your proxy is no longer baked into the APK at patch time. Changes apply to new connections straight away.
  * **Test connection** checks your proxy and tells you what's wrong if it doesn't work.
  * The patch options in Morphe Manager are now optional starting values.
* **Run without proxy switch.** Turn the proxy off and on from the same screen. Switch **Run without proxy** on and the app connects directly. Leave it off (the default) and everything goes through your proxy, and the app stays offline if the proxy isn't working.

## Saiyan007 1.1.0

A Morphe patch for **Shima: Dynamic Island** (`com.piyush.island`).

- Unlocks Pro features.
- Automatically includes the Google Play installer-source fix.
- Targets any Shima version with matching bytecode.

Download **Saiyan007-1.1.0.mpp**, load it in Morphe, and select **Saiyan007** when
patching your original Shima APK or XAPK.

Build, patch application, APK signature, and bytecode checks passed on Shima
**0.4.0 (version code 7)**. Other versions and the rebuilt APK's on-device behavior
have not been verified.

Source code and Windows build instructions are included in the repository.
